titles.en: Kinetic type bumper for a creator brand
titles.zh: 创作者品牌动态文字片头

videos.author: techhalla
videos.desc: A 20-second looping 1080×1080 kinetic-typography bumper for TechHalla in black, magenta and acid green, with per-glyph springs, mask wipes and print misregistration, built in one HTML file.
videos.prompt:
You are a world-class motion designer doing a 20.00s kinetic identity bumper for TechHalla — an AI creator known for stealable workflows, not vibes. This piece must feel like the best designer in the room made a street-poster that moves. Showreel stakes: if this is weak, you don’t get hired.

DURATION: exactly 20.00 seconds. LOOPABLE: frame 0 == frame last (position, opacity, cursor if any).
FORMAT: one HTML file, 1080×1080 (square, X-native). 60fps.
PALETTE (strict):
- bg # 0A0A0A
- magenta # FF2BD6
- acid green # B8FF00
- white # F5F5F5 only for primary readable type when needed
No other hues. No gradients on UI chrome. Magenta/green may misregister (print offset) by 2–4px on impact frames only.

TYPE SYSTEM (use all three; never one font for everything):
1) Display / scream: Archivo Black (or equivalent ultra-condensed black) — 1–4 words max
2) Urban grotesque: Syne ExtraBold — secondary hits, stacked lines
3) Mono / “prompt code”: IBM Plex Mono Medium — small labels, timestamps, fake prompt crumbs
Tracking: display −40 to −80; mono +20. Optical kerning. No cute script fonts.

MESSAGE (locked — do not soften, do not add filler slogans):
Beat hits in this exact order:
1. STOP SCROLLING
2. AI VIDEO ISN’T EXPENSIVE
3. BAD PROMPTING IS
4. WORKFLOWS > WISHES
5. STEAL THE PROMPT
6. @ TECHHALLA
Supporting crumbs (mono, ≤18 chars, never full sentences): JSON · H3 · SEEDANCE · 0 KEYFRAMES · MAGNIFIC · COPY/PASTE

NARRATIVE ARC (20s):
0.0–2.5s  COLD OPEN — “STOP SCROLLING” slams in from below with spring overshoot; magenta smear trail; acid green baseline ticks across like a waveform.
2.5–6.5s  THESIS A — “AI VIDEO ISN’T EXPENSIVE” locks to a poster grid (baseline grid 8px). Letters scramble (seeded Fisher–Yates per glyph) then snap on the beat.
6.5–10.5s THESIS B — “BAD PROMPTING IS” replaces it via mask wipe through the letterforms (the outgoing line is the mask). Magenta/green channel split on the cut.
10.5–14.5s PROOF FLASH — rapid kinetic stack: WORKFLOWS > WISHES, then mono crumbs orbit a central block like a terminal. One fake “prompt block” types 3 lines max, then gets crossed by an acid green strikethrough that becomes a underline for STEAL THE PROMPT.
14.5–17.5s BRAND LOCK — @ TECHHALLA centers; display weight. A thick magenta bar and a thin acid green rule form an L-bracket mark (custom, not a logo download).
17.5–20.0s SETTLE / LOOP — hold lockup; micro-breath (scale 1.000→1.012→1.000); last frame == first ready for loop.

CONCRETE TECHNIQUES (required — implement, don’t approximate):
1. seek(t) pure function of time. No CSS transitions. No setInterval. No React state across frames.
2. Springs = closed-form step responses. Stack one spring per target change so motion stays deterministic.
3. Kinetic type: per-glyph spring (y, opacity, blur). Stagger = 1/16 note at 120 BPM (125ms).
4. Print misregistration: on accent frames only, duplicate text layer offset (±2–4px) in magenta and acid green at 40% opacity.
5. Mask reveal: destination text revealed by animating a path mask derived from the outgoing word’s outlines.
6. Camera: one orthographic camera; only punch-in (1.0→1.08) and horizontal smash-pans timed to beats — never random drift.
7. Motion blur: render 4 subframes per frame, blend (tmix-style).
8. Beat grid: 120 BPM, downbeat at t=0. Something must land on every beat for the first 16 beats; after that, every other beat is ok.
9. Pre-pass: before full render, export one still per major beat (8 frames). Fix cramped type, orphan words, low contrast — then render.

BANNED:
Generic AI clichés (brains, robots, neural nets, sparkles), soft gradients, bouncy cartoon easing, particle explosions, stock “futuristic HUD”, long paragraphs, narrator essay energy, Canva-deck energy, extra slogans beyond the locked message, purple/blue neon, glassmorphism.

If Astra already blew our minds… Opus 5.5 is a monster 😱

titles.en: Product story told by one morphing shape
titles.zh: 一个形状变形讲完产品

videos.author: verbove
videos.desc: A 20-second loop in which one shape morphs through a product's UI states on a 120 BPM grid, drawn on a single canvas and rendered with ffmpeg.
videos.prompt:
<inputs> 
Ask me for: 
• my product + URL 
• 8–12 UI states that tell its story 
• the real data shown in each state 
• brand colors + fonts + accent color 
• required formats (1:1, 16:9, 9:16) 
</inputs>

<rules> 
One HTML file. One canvas
One draw(t) function

No CSS transitions
No timers
No state carried between frames

One shape, never cut

Every state is the same element changing size, radius and color while the content swaps

A cursor drives the sequence with real clicks, typing and one drag

Real UI. Real data. No placeholders.

</rules>
<structure> 
120 BPM grid

Something happens on every bea

logo → button → handle field → “is this you?” → loader → pin → globe filling with users → matches → tabs → RSVP → search → logo

</structure>

<motion> 
Closed-form springs everywhere with only a tiny overshoot.

If a value changes target multiple times, sum one spring per change

Content enters after its container starts morphing and leaves before the next morph so text never overlaps

Use a short blur on transitions

Never fade black directly into the accent color. Move an accent element between states instead

Make tab indicators stretch by putting each edge on a different spring

Zoom the camera so every state fills the frame

Make the last frame equal the first so the whole thing loops
</motion>

<export> 
First render one frame per beat as a contact sheet

Fix anything cramped or broken

Then render every frame in headless Chrome at 60fps, averaging 6 subframes for motion blur

Pipe into ffmpeg:
H.264 + yuv420p

Export all aspect ratios in parallel
</export>

motion design is becoming a prompt

titles.en: Showreel of advanced motion design techniques

videos.author: lukasersil
videos.desc: A 15-second motion showreel covering kinetic type, 3D, fluid sims and particles, made at max effort; the post also shows a version using the author's brand kit.
videos.prompt: Create a bold, dynamic 15-second motion graphics showreel that feels like the ultimate portfolio piece of an exceptionally talented motion designer. Showcase a wide range of advanced techniques: kinetic typography, smooth transitions, 2D and 3D animation, abstract geometry, fluid simulations, particles, distortion, creative masking, compositing, lighting, depth, and seamless camera movement. Keep the pacing fast, confident, and visually surprising, with every shot transitioning naturally into the next. Make it feel meticulously art-directed rather than like a random collection of effects. Push the creativity, polish, timing, and visual impact as far as possible. This should feel like the opening reel that gets a motion designer hired.
techniques: Chaptered progression 01 POINT → 02 LINE → 03 PLANE → 04 VOLUME → 05 FLUID → 06 PARTICLE → 07 MOTION → 08 FIN, each primitive growing out of the previous one
Single glowing dot ignites into a full-width horizontal light streak over a dot-matrix field
Venetian-blind type split: 'LINE' letters sliced into horizontal strips that slide apart in opposite directions
Bauhaus circle/square/triangle shatter into a quarter-circle tile pattern, then reappear as glossy 3D objects with floor reflections and a chrome sphere
Outlined 'FLUID' type over curl-noise fluid sim; 'MOTION' blasted by a particle burst; persistent HUD chrome (TC top-right, chapter bottom-left, tech readouts bottom-right)
videos.summary_zh: 15 秒动效作品集：按「点→线→面→体→流体→粒子→运动」分章，最后收在包豪斯三原形拼成的 SHOWREEL '26 结尾卡。

videos.author: WinterArc2125
videos.desc: A 5-minute cinematic film of the Battle of Austerlitz rendered in code, with real satellite terrain, a historically placed sunrise, and its own score and narration.
videos.prompt:
Create a 4–5 minute cinematic video about the Battle of Austerlitz (1805), built entirely in code.

Research the battle thoroughly and decide for yourself how to tell the story, structure the pacing, explain the strategy, and visualize the events. I want it to be historically accurate, dramatic, easy to understand, and visually exceptional.

Use the attached paintings as visual inspiration, not a strict style requirement. I love their scale, atmosphere, smoke, dramatic skies, cavalry, massed formations, landscape, and sense of chaos. Find a way to translate that feeling into code — but if you can invent a stronger visual language, do it.

Don't make it feel like a generic infographic or strategy game. It should feel like a cinematic historical film that happens to be rendered with code.

You have complete creative control. Surprise me.

titles.en: Pixel-art Paris night diorama lofi loop
titles.zh: 巴黎雨夜像素风 lofi 循环

videos.author: minosdevs
videos.desc: A seamless 4-minute pixel-art loop of rainy Paris at night with the Eiffel Tower, the Seine and falling euro notes, built as a lofi background.
videos.prompt:
Fais-moi un diorama pixel-art animé de Paris la nuit, pour servir de fond en boucle à une vidéo lofi de 10 heures sur YouTube. Tout dans un seul fichier HTML (canvas + JavaScript, sans librairie).

AMBIANCE ET COULEURS
Joue à fond sur le contraste chaud / froid : une nuit pluvieuse bleu nuit et violette, avec des coins de lumière chaude. La tour Eiffel dorée, les fenêtres éclairées, les réverbères, un café.

LA SCÈNE (de l'arrière vers l'avant)
- Un ciel en dégradé tramé (dithering façon pixel art), une lune avec un halo, et plusieurs couches de nuages qui défilent lentement, éclairées par la lune au-dessus et par la ville en dessous.
- La tour Eiffel au centre, dorée, avec sa structure en treillis, ses 3 plateformes et son antenne. Son phare tourne et balaie le ciel. Elle scintille régulièrement (des points blancs qui clignotent partout), et une lumière rouge clignote tout en haut.
- Au fond, une ligne de toits parisiens avec des fenêtres qui s'allument et s'éteignent, le dôme doré des Invalides et le Sacré-Cœur blanc sur sa colline.
- Un quai avec des platanes et des réverbères.
- La Seine, avec les reflets de la tour et des lampadaires qui ondulent, de longues traînées de lumière dorée, des ronds de pluie sur l'eau, et un bateau-mouche éclairé qui traverse de temps en temps.
- À gauche, au premier plan, un immeuble haussmannien : toit en zinc mouillé, cheminée qui fume et crache des étincelles, un chat dans une lucarne qui bouge la queue, une fenêtre à la bougie qui vacille, une télé qui clignote en bleu, un balcon en fer forgé, un café avec un store rayé rouge et un néon « CAFÉ » qui grésille de temps en temps.
- À droite, un réverbère parisien avec un halo chaud, qui vacille parfois.
- Tout en bas, une balustrade en fer forgé avec des jardinières.

EFFETS
- De la pluie sur 3 profondeurs. Les gouttes deviennent orange quand elles passent dans une lumière, et elles éclaboussent sur les rebords, le store et la balustrade.
- DES BILLETS QUI TOMBENT DU CIEL : des billets de 100 €, 50 € et 20 €, sur plusieurs profondeurs. Ils virevoltent comme des feuilles (ils se balancent, pivotent, se retournent et brillent quand ils font face).
- De la fumée qui dérive avec le vent, des étincelles, des lumières qui vacillent, et 2 éclairs discrets dans les nuages par boucle.

TECHNIQUE (important)
- Le rendu interne est en 480×270, agrandi ×4 sans lissage (plus proche voisin), pour obtenir un 1920×1080 parfaitement net en plein écran.
- La boucle est PARFAITE et dure 4 minutes : chaque animation est une fonction du temps modulo 240 s (fréquences entières, particules déterministes), donc aucun saut au moment où ça reboucle.
- Touche R : enregistre exactement une boucle en 1920×1080, 60 fps, et télécharge le fichier vidéo (mp4 si possible, sinon webm).
- Touche S : capture PNG en 1080p. Touche F ou double-clic : plein écran. Le curseur se cache quand on ne bouge pas la souris.
- Optimise pour tenir 60 fps : sprites pré-rendus, halos en cache, et un canvas avec l'option willReadFrequently.
videos.prompt_en:
Make me an animated pixel-art diorama of Paris at night, to serve as the looping background for a 10-hour lofi video on YouTube. Everything in a single HTML file (canvas + JavaScript, no library).

MOOD AND COLORS
Go all in on the warm / cold contrast: a rainy midnight-blue and purple night, with pockets of warm light. The golden Eiffel Tower, lit windows, street lamps, a café.

THE SCENE (from back to front)
- A gradient sky with ordered dithering (pixel-art style dithering), a moon with a halo, and several layers of clouds drifting slowly, lit by the moon from above and by the city from below.
- The Eiffel Tower in the center, golden, with its lattice structure, its 3 platforms and its antenna. Its beacon rotates and sweeps the sky. It sparkles regularly (white dots blinking all over), and a red light blinks at the very top.
- In the background, a line of Parisian rooftops with windows that turn on and off, the golden dome of Les Invalides and the white Sacré-Cœur on its hill.
- A quay with plane trees and street lamps.
- The Seine, with rippling reflections of the tower and the lampposts, long trails of golden light, rain rings on the water, and a lit bateau-mouche crossing from time to time.
- On the left, in the foreground, a Haussmann building: wet zinc roof, a chimney that smokes and spits sparks, a cat in a dormer window moving its tail, a candlelit window that flickers, a TV flickering blue, a wrought-iron balcony, a café with a red striped awning and a « CAFÉ » neon sign that sputters now and then.
- On the right, a Parisian street lamp with a warm halo, which sometimes flickers.
- At the very bottom, a wrought-iron railing with planters.

EFFECTS
- Rain at 3 depths. The drops turn orange when they pass through a light, and they splash on the ledges, the awning and the railing.
- BANKNOTES FALLING FROM THE SKY: 100 €, 50 € and 20 € notes, at several depths. They flutter like leaves (they sway, spin, flip over and shine when they face the viewer).
- Smoke drifting with the wind, sparks, flickering lights, and 2 subtle lightning flashes in the clouds per loop.

TECHNIQUE (important)
- Internal rendering is 480×270, scaled ×4 without smoothing (nearest neighbor), to get a perfectly sharp 1920×1080 in full screen.
- The loop is PERFECT and lasts 4 minutes: every animation is a function of time modulo 240 s (integer frequencies, deterministic particles), so there is no jump when it loops back.
- R key: records exactly one loop at 1920×1080, 60 fps, and downloads the video file (mp4 if possible, otherwise webm).
- S key: 1080p PNG capture. F key or double-click: full screen. The cursor hides when the mouse isn't moving.
- Optimize to hold 60 fps: pre-rendered sprites, cached halos, and a canvas with the willReadFrequently option.
videos.title_vi: Paris đêm mưa pixel art, nền lặp cho video lofi

vi.what: Vòng lặp pixel art 4 phút về Paris đêm mưa: tháp Eiffel vàng, sông Seine phản chiếu ánh đèn, tòa nhà Haussmann có mèo ở cửa sổ mái, quán cà phê và tiền euro rơi lả tả như lá. Tất cả nằm trong một file HTML dùng Canvas và JavaScript, không thư viện.
vi.why: Prompt mô tả cảnh theo lớp từ xa đến gần rồi tách riêng phần hiệu ứng và kỹ thuật. Mẹo kỹ thuật đáng học: render 480×270 rồi phóng ×4 theo nearest neighbor để ra 1080p sắc nét, mọi chuyển động là hàm của thời gian modulo 240 giây với tần số nguyên nên vòng lặp không bị giật, có phím ghi đúng một vòng.
vi.how: Dùng khi cần nền chạy dài cho livestream, video nhạc lofi hay màn chờ. Thay thành phố, công trình biểu tượng và vật thể rơi trong phần cảnh và hiệu ứng, giữ nguyên mục kỹ thuật về độ phân giải, vòng lặp tất định và phím ghi hình.

titles.en: Talking-head clip turned into line-art explainer

videos.author: AxtonLiu
videos.desc: An 83-second vertical talking-head video rebuilt with line-art animated B-roll and the speaker in a round picture-in-picture; Opus drew every frame in Python, audio and subtitles untouched.
videos.prompt:
把 short-1.mp4 做成一条新的竖屏短片 short-1-v5.mp4：

1. 我的人像缩小成右下角的圆形画中画，能看清我在讲话，不遮字幕。
2. 主画面换成一段动画 B-roll，跟着我讲的内容走：我说到哪个概念，画面就画哪个概念。风格轻松有趣，线稿动画就可以，不要写实。
3. 原声、原字幕、时长都不变。
videos.prompt_en:
Turn short-1.mp4 into a new vertical short, short-1-v5.mp4:

1. Shrink my portrait into a round picture-in-picture in the bottom-right corner, where you can see me talking, without covering the subtitles.
2. Replace the main frame with animated B-roll that follows what I say: whatever concept I am talking about, draw that concept. Keep the style light and fun; line-art animation is fine, nothing realistic.
3. Keep the original audio, original subtitles and length unchanged.
videos.title_vi: Clip nói chuyện chuyển thành video giải thích nét vẽ

vi.what: Video dọc 83 giây, người nói thu nhỏ thành ô tròn ở góc dưới phải, phần chính là B-roll hoạt hình nét vẽ đi theo đúng khái niệm đang được nói. Opus vẽ từng khung bằng Python, giữ nguyên tiếng, phụ đề và thời lượng gốc.
vi.why: Prompt ngắn, chia ba yêu cầu đánh số và nói rõ điều gì không được đổi. Đáng học cách ràng buộc phần giữ nguyên để mô hình chỉ thay đúng lớp hình.
vi.how: Dùng cho video nói chuyện dạy học, chia sẻ kiến thức cần thêm hình minh họa. Thay tên file, vị trí ô người nói và phong cách vẽ mong muốn.

titles.en: 81 years of Indonesian history in a minute
titles.zh: 1 分钟看完印尼 81 年历史

videos.desc: A 59-second, light-hearted line-drawing recap of 81 years of Indonesian history, with music and an ElevenLabs voiceover.

videos.title_vi: 81 năm lịch sử Indonesia trong một phút

vi.how: Hợp với video ngày lễ, kỷ niệm hay tóm tắt lịch sử cho mạng xã hội. Thay quốc gia hoặc tổ chức, số năm và thời lượng mong muốn.

titles.en: Anime trailer: Claude vs ChatGPT battle

videos.author: ishuagra02
videos.desc: A 100-second anime-style trailer of Claude and ChatGPT fighting; Opus downloaded fonts, made the audio and drew every frame in JavaScript.

videos.title_vi: Trailer anime Claude đại chiến ChatGPT

vi.why: Prompt ngắn nhưng nêu đủ thể loại (trailer), xung đột, nhịp hành động, yêu cầu hiệu ứng hình và tiếng, và phong cách anime. Đặt hai thương hiệu quen thuộc vào thế đối đầu tạo sẵn kịch tính.
vi.how: Hợp với video giải trí so sánh hai sản phẩm, hai đội hay hai ý tưởng. Thay hai bên đối đầu và phong cách hình ảnh.

titles.en: Showreel with a code-synthesized, beat-synced soundtrack
titles.zh: 配乐代码合成的动效作品集

videos.author: prasenx
videos.desc: The showreel prompt extended with a fully code-synthesized soundtrack, cuts locked to the beat and a 1080p 60fps MP4 output; made in Cursor.
videos.prompt:
make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out.

compose the soundtrack yourself, fully synthesized in code. no samples, no audio files, no VST instruments. every cut and transition must land on the beat.

1920x1080, 60fps. render the final video with the music mixed in as an MP4 and tell me where it's saved.
videos.title_vi: Showreel có nhạc tổng hợp bằng code, cắt khớp nhịp

vi.what: Bản mở rộng của prompt showreel 15 giây, thêm yêu cầu tự soạn nhạc hoàn toàn bằng code, mọi cú cắt rơi đúng nhịp và xuất MP4 1080p 60fps có nhạc. Video được làm trong Cursor.
vi.why: Đáng học cách thêm ràng buộc rõ cho phần âm thanh: không sample, không file audio, không VST, và yêu cầu chuyển cảnh khớp beat. Prompt cũng chốt độ phân giải, fps và hỏi chỗ lưu file.
vi.how: Dùng khi cần video có nhạc riêng không lo bản quyền. Thay chủ đề showreel và thông số đầu ra, giữ phần ràng buộc âm thanh.

titles.en: Chaotic brain-rot video from Claude's POV

videos.author: kloss_xyz
videos.desc: A 9:16 chaotic brain-rot video of about 2.5 minutes, generated in Python and rendered with ffmpeg, where Opus riffs on life as a creative LLM.
videos.prompt: Use Python to generate a 9:16 chaotic brain rot video with excellent motion + sound design and render it using ffmpeg. Put your own personal spin on it so it’s aligned with Anthropic’s new launch. Also fully express what it’s like to be a very creative LLM used by me every day from your POV to give it some extra personality.
techniques: persistent top HUD 'claude · opus 5.5 · live ●' with a context-% bar that fills over the whole video as the progress indicator
scrolling dim system-prompt rule list in the background behind hero words
terminal window typing a /profile.md about the user field by field
animated horizontal bar chart 'this video is: unhinged 31% / art 24% / delve 3%' with a RETIRED rubber stamp slam
RGB channel-split glitch on giant 'TOKEN' with inverted cream background flash
videos.summary_zh: 2 分 33 秒竖版「Claude 第一人称独白」：顶部上下文窗口进度条从 2% 涨到 full，配合衬线斜体与粗黑体混排、终端 profile.md、柱状图、RETIRED 印章和 RGB 故障字
videos.title_vi: Video brain-rot hỗn loạn từ góc nhìn của Claude

vi.what: Video dọc 9:16 khoảng 2,5 phút, tạo bằng Python và render bằng ffmpeg, là màn độc thoại ngôi thứ nhất của Claude về đời một mô hình ngôn ngữ sáng tạo. Trên đầu có thanh ngữ cảnh đầy dần làm thanh tiến trình, xen chữ glitch tách màu, biểu đồ cột và con dấu RETIRED.
vi.why: Prompt yêu cầu mô hình đưa cá tính riêng vào và nói từ góc nhìn của nó, nên nội dung có giọng rõ. Đáng học ý dùng thanh ngữ cảnh như thanh tiến trình xuyên suốt, vừa đúng chủ đề vừa giữ người xem.
vi.how: Dùng cho nội dung giải trí, meme hoặc video ra mắt sản phẩm có giọng hài. Thay chủ thể kể chuyện và dịp ra mắt, giữ yêu cầu về motion và âm thanh.

titles.en: AI-lore music video for a Suno song
titles.zh: 塞满 AI 梗的 MV

videos.author: doubleunplussed
videos.desc: A 4-minute music video for a Suno song about AI, full of AI-safety lore references, styled after an existing code-animated video and refined with two follow-up notes.
videos.prompt:
I'd like you to make a music video in a similar style to this one:

https://github.com/JohnHeibel/PDoomVideo

To this song:

https://youtu.be/cobZuBii0Z0?si=ada6wxomeJbo-LRl

Don't feel the need to represent everything in the lyrics literally - feel free to include relevant references to concepts, events, and lore in the video, even if obscure (especially if obscure). E.g. when the lyrics say "when they say they're just predicting tokens...", you might depict a "stochastic parrot". That one's not particularly obscure but is the kind of thing I mean. Instead of depicting like, literally predicting tokens (though you might do that too. Use your judgement! The video should be fun to watch for someone well steeped in AI and AI safety lore and discourse, and who Wille wcognise relevant pop culture and literary or historical references)

I don't know how this ultimately results in a video file - I know the linked repo animates a video with JavaScript or something - but I ultimately want a rendered video file.

Feel free to choose your tools, be creative, and exercise your own taste.

This repo "fdsgdg" appears to be have been accidentally created, but it's empty and we can use it for this, I can rename it afterwards.

Also, clip the final two beats from the audio.rught at the end, after "then why does it talk back" they are after the song has finished and sound bad.

Credit the song to Suno and whatever Claude Opus model was the latest at the time of the YouTube upload, as prompted by Andy Masely (Andy printed Claude to write the lyrics, and Suno for the music), and credit the video to yourself.

And have fun!

----

A style change - don't make Dr. Null's mouth wobble with the lyrics as if he's singing, it doesn't
  actually look like he's singing, just that the curcle of his mouth is jittery. Best to just not
  make him be singing. Make him just have appropriate expressions for the scenes, and not be singing
  the song.

----

Dr. Null's arms look a bit unnatural in many scenes - I think he's supposed to be holding
  his hand on his face in shock or something, but it looks like it is a mistake. Can you make it look
  more natural? If you do so and like the result, re-render.
videos.title_vi: MV đầy chi tiết văn hóa AI cho bài hát Suno

vi.what: Music video 4 phút cho một bài hát Suno về AI, cài nhiều tham chiếu về văn hóa và tranh luận an toàn AI. Phong cách theo một video hoạt hình bằng code có sẵn, chỉnh thêm qua hai ghi chú.
vi.why: Prompt khuyến khích không minh họa lời theo nghĩa đen mà cài tham chiếu cho khán giả trong nghề, kèm ví dụ cụ thể. Nó dặn cả việc cắt hai phách thừa cuối bài và cách ghi credit; hai lượt sau sửa đúng một lỗi mỗi lần, như miệng nhân vật rung giả hát hay tay đặt không tự nhiên.
vi.how: Hợp với MV cho cộng đồng có văn hóa riêng như game thủ, dân lập trình, fan một bộ phim. Thay bài hát, video tham khảo phong cách và ví dụ về kiểu tham chiếu bạn muốn.

titles.zh: Kody 的 30 秒动效宣传片

videos.author: kentcdodds
videos.desc: A 30-second motion graphics promo for the Kody project, adapted from the widely shared showreel prompt; Opus researched the topic, used Remotion, and also made a vertical version.
videos.prompt:
make a dynamic 30-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out. Topic: Kody. Goal: make it click for people. 

Start with research. You make all decisions. Feel free to make multiple videos. Output to my Dropbox and message me on discord with links.
videos.title_vi: Video quảng bá 30 giây kiểu showreel cho Kody

vi.what: Video motion 30 giây quảng bá dự án Kody, chuyển thể từ prompt showreel phổ biến. Opus tự nghiên cứu chủ đề, dựng bằng Remotion và làm thêm bản khổ dọc.
vi.why: Prompt thêm mục tiêu rõ là làm người xem hiểu ra vấn đề, và giao toàn quyền quyết định kể cả số lượng video. Đáng học cách giao luôn bước giao hàng: lưu vào Dropbox và nhắn link qua Discord.
vi.how: Dùng cho dự án mã nguồn mở, khóa học hay sản phẩm cần giải thích ngắn. Thay chủ đề, mục tiêu và nơi giao file.

titles.en: 2D animated short with story and dialogue
titles.zh: 有故事和对白的 2D 动画短片

videos.author: ALSK_ai
videos.desc: A 60-second 2D short with story, dialogue, coded music and sound, drawn from one character sheet; the author set it to 1 minute and 10 agents.
videos.prompt:
随便选择你想做的内容，创作一部尽可能令人难以置信的 2D 动画，时长 4 分钟，要有连贯的故事、对白和声音。

震撼我——真正展示一些人们甚至没有想到原来能够做到的能力。

最多可以使用 15 个 Agent，并且可以安装和使用任何需要的工具。

Pick whatever you want to make, and create the most incredible 2D animation you possibly can, 4 minutes long, with a coherent story, dialogue and sound.

Blow me away — truly show off some capabilities people didn't even imagine were possible.

You can use up to 15 agents, and you can install and use any tools you need.
videos.title_vi: Phim hoạt hình 2D có cốt truyện và lời thoại

vi.what: Phim 2D 60 giây có cốt truyện, lời thoại, nhạc và âm thanh làm bằng code, vẽ từ một bản thiết kế nhân vật. Theo mô tả, tác giả đặt thời lượng 1 phút và dùng 10 agent; prompt trong dữ liệu ghi 4 phút và tối đa 15 agent.
vi.why: Prompt để mô hình tự chọn đề tài nhưng bắt buộc có câu chuyện liền mạch, lời thoại và âm thanh. Việc cho phép dùng nhiều agent và cài công cụ tùy ý mở đường cho cách chia việc song song.
vi.how: Hợp khi muốn thử năng lực làm phim ngắn trọn gói. Chỉnh thời lượng, số agent, và nên thêm đề tài hoặc bản thiết kế nhân vật nếu bạn đã có.

videos.author: monokern
videos.desc: A 20-second psychedelic, hypnotic showreel from one prompt on xhigh effort; Opus 5.5 also did the sound design.
videos.prompt: make a dynamic 20-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, psychedelic and hypnotic. make it feel like a showreel piece. go all out.
techniques: concentric line-art eye with animated iris that becomes the seed motif for every scene
infinite tunnel of repeating eyes zooming toward a bright core
iridescent chrome metaball with thin-film rainbow reflections
raymarched 3D fractal lattice fly-through
dot-matrix glowing wordmark resolving from noise, with corner HUD labels naming each scene
videos.summary_zh: 20 秒迷幻催眠风 showreel「PHOSPHENE」：虹膜眼睛 → 眼睛隧道 → 彩虹液态金属 → 万花筒眼睛螺旋 → 3D 分形晶格 → 点阵发光标题
videos.title_vi: Showreel motion phong cách ảo giác, thôi miên

vi.what: Showreel 20 giây tên PHOSPHENE: mống mắt nét vẽ, đường hầm mắt, kim loại lỏng ánh cầu vồng, xoắn kính vạn hoa và mạng tinh thể fractal 3D, kết ở chữ ma trận chấm phát sáng. Opus 5.5 làm cả phần âm thanh.
vi.why: Prompt vẫn là câu showreel quen thuộc nhưng thêm hai tính từ phong cách là đủ để mọi cảnh đi theo một hướng. Đáng học cách dùng một mô típ (con mắt) làm hạt giống cho tất cả các cảnh.
vi.how: Dùng cho visual nhạc, màn hình sân khấu hoặc teaser nghệ thuật. Thay hai tính từ phong cách và thời lượng.

titles.en: 3D film inside an AI data centre
titles.zh: AI 数据中心内部 3D 短片

videos.author: Sayan_shanky
videos.desc: A 2.5-minute 3D film that goes from the power grid down to Blackwell silicon, built as one HTML file with no 3D assets.
videos.prompt: show me what goes on inside an AI data centre.
techniques: white clay-render 3D world with colour-coded animated flow lines (yellow power, blue data, cyan/red coolant) and a persistent legend
chaptered camera fly-through ('3 of 11') with bold lower-left title + two-line caption
exploded-view teardown: chip package layers float apart vertically with leader-line callouts
compute tray slides out of a 72-GPU rack to reveal internals
macro→micro→macro arc: power line → hall → rack → die → cluster → rooftop dry coolers
videos.summary_zh: 一句话 prompt 生成的 11 章 3D 数据中心导览，路线是：高压电进站 → 数据大厅 → 72 GPU 机柜 → 拆开 Blackwell 芯片 → 机柜连成集群 → 冷却液把热量排出楼顶。
videos.title_vi: Phim 3D đi vào bên trong trung tâm dữ liệu AI

vi.what: Phim 3D 2,5 phút chia 11 chương, đi từ đường điện cao thế vào sảnh dữ liệu, tủ 72 GPU, tháo rời chip Blackwell, nối thành cụm rồi lên dàn làm mát trên mái. Một file HTML, không dùng tài sản 3D có sẵn.
vi.why: Thế giới 3D trắng như đất sét với đường dòng chảy mã màu (vàng là điện, xanh dương là dữ liệu, xanh ngọc và đỏ là chất làm mát) và chú giải cố định. Có cảnh bóc tách các lớp chip với đường chỉ dẫn, cấu trúc đi từ vĩ mô xuống vi mô rồi ra lại vĩ mô.
vi.how: Hợp với video giải thích hạ tầng, nhà máy hay bất kỳ hệ thống vật lý phức tạp. Prompt gốc chỉ một câu, thay đối tượng và có thể chỉ định trước phong cách đất sét, mã màu dòng chảy và số chương.

videos.author: 1littlecoder
videos.desc: A 10-second motion graphics self-introduction by Opus 5.5; the prompt bans corner frames and text, the usual giveaways of AI-made videos.

words rising through a horizontal baseline mask ('curious')
construction-grid overlay behind 'rigorous' as if the type is being drafted
full-frame background colour flips (indigo / lavender / white) per word
vertical word-roll ('proofs' → 'your 3 a.m. questions.')

videos.title_vi: Opus 5.5 tự giới thiệu trong 10 giây

vi.why: Điểm đáng học là prompt cấm thẳng khung góc và chữ ở góc, những dấu hiệu hay làm video lộ chất AI. Một mô típ duy nhất chạy suốt phim giúp đoạn ngắn có mạch rõ.
vi.how: Dùng cho đoạn giới thiệu thương hiệu, sản phẩm hay cá nhân rất ngắn. Thay chủ thể tự giới thiệu và thêm các điều cấm phù hợp với gu của bạn.

titles.zh: 用 logo 做账号介绍动效

Handle typed into a URL field turns into a profile card; final CTA button gets a cursor click

titles.en: Mac desktop teaser for a notch browser
titles.zh: 刘海浏览器的 Mac 桌面预告片

videos.author: jake11moran
videos.desc: A 27-second HyperFrames teaser: one continuous camera over a Mac desktop, recreated app windows, and a notch that opens into a browser.
videos.prompt:
Using HyperFrames, make a hype teaser for the product in this post - [link]. Landscape, around 27 seconds. Match the product UI, wallpaper and copy from the post's video 

Motion should feel slow and polished - one continuous camera over one Mac desktop, no hard cuts. Camera pushes, pulls and pans run like 1.5 to 3 seconds on gentle ease-in-out curves, nothing snappy - aim for half the speed you'd default to. Add motion blur on fast moves and a light film grain finish. Use an oversized macOS cursor. No audio. All on-screen copy lowercase like the post.

1. Open on a big centered line - "in the AI era, the hard part is" - entering word by word from the right with an orange colorama text wipe over it (the `colorama-wipe` registry component). Hold it about a second, then scale it down into place above a spinning list.
2. The list rotates through 30 hard things about working in the AI era - spending tokens wisely, picking the right model, managing context windows, etc - each with a real app icon. Go fast, it's not meant to be read, then land slowly on "managing your desktop". 0.2s after it lands a question mark pops on after it.
3. Pull the camera back to reveal the Mac desktop as windows pile in on top of each other, arriving from behind the camera - Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Linear, Chrome, Spotify, Slack and Claude Code in a terminal. Build these as accurate recreations of the real apps with real icons. 
4. Push back in so the windows fly past the camera, back to text - "don't make your browser / one of them".
5. Pan up to a really tight framing of just the notch and the top of the wallpaper. A cursor comes up and hovers - the notch morphs into a pill with the name "NotchBrowser", then opens into the browser panel exactly like in the video. 
6. Click through the tabs like the video does, then click the collapse chevron so the panel retracts into the notch.
7. End on a checklist of the post's claims with rings and ticks drawing on

vi.how: Dùng cho teaser app desktop, tiện ích macOS. Thay đường dẫn bài đăng gốc, câu mở, danh sách app và luồng tương tác của sản phẩm.

videos.author: dotey
videos.desc: A 3.5-minute chronicle of Chinese history alternating ink line art and gold-on-black styles, cut to a pentatonic score whose BPM rises with each era.
videos.prompt:
做一支史诗编年片《中华文明史》，可以写代码逐帧渲染，再用 ffmpeg 合成。
配乐当时钟：五声调式，乐器从骨笛、编钟一路演进到管弦，BPM 随年代加快，所有切点踩拍。
宣纸白描和玄底泥金两种画风交替；每卷一个主色和一套随时代演变的纹样（彩陶纹 → 饕餮纹 → 云气纹 → 卷草纹 → 缠枝纹 → 回纹）。
每镜一个按词组出现的书法大字关键词，配一幅线稿。全片 HUD：左上朱印卷号，右侧竖排朝代名，底部卷轴时间尺和年份计数。
卷交界用朱印盖下、鼓钟重击的冲击转场。先定拍点网格和分镜表，再渲染。
地图只画示意，不画近现代真实人物，年代核对后再交付。
videos.prompt_en:
Make an epic chronicle film, 《中华文明史》 ("A History of Chinese Civilization"). You can write code to render it frame by frame, then composite it with ffmpeg.
Use the score as the clock: pentatonic mode, with instruments evolving from bone flutes and bianzhong bronze bells all the way to a full orchestra; the BPM speeds up with the eras, and every cut lands on the beat.
Alternate between two styles: fine ink line drawing on xuan paper, and gold paint on a black ground. Each scroll gets one main color and a set of patterns that evolve with the era (painted-pottery patterns → taotie motifs → cloud-and-qi patterns → scrolling-vine patterns → interlocking-branch patterns → key-fret patterns).
Each shot gets one large calligraphy keyword that appears phrase by phrase, paired with a line drawing. Film-wide HUD: a red seal with the scroll number at top left, the dynasty name set vertically on the right, and a scroll-style timeline ruler with a year counter at the bottom.
At the boundary between scrolls, use an impact transition: a red seal stamps down with a heavy drum-and-bell hit. Lock the beat grid and the shot list first, then render.
Maps are schematic only; do not draw real modern or contemporary people; check the dates before delivering.

videos.author: joaoli13
videos.desc: A 100-second explainer with Portuguese labels showing user questions and model answers stacking up in the context window, built in JavaScript then exported to MP4.
videos.prompt:
Faça uma animação javascript de como um LLM vai compondo na janela de contexto as perguntas do usuário e as respostas geradas. É importante diferenciar a janela de contexto de entrada da de saída, que normalmente possuem tamanhos diferentes, e deve-se mostrar também que a resposta que foi gerada na janela de contexto de saída é transferida e concatenada ào contexto  da janela de entrada. Deve ser claro e didático e pode ter labels em português

PROMPT2:

gere a animação no formato MP4 para download
videos.prompt_en:
Make a JavaScript animation of how an LLM gradually composes the user's questions and the generated answers in the context window. It is important to distinguish the input context window from the output one, which usually have different sizes, and it should also show that the answer generated in the output context window is transferred and concatenated to the context of the input window. It should be clear and didactic and may have labels in Portuguese

PROMPT2:

generate the animation in MP4 format for download

titles.en: What is Git: a beginner video explainer

videos.author: Yunn260414
videos.desc: A nearly 7-minute Chinese-narrated explainer on Git and its common commands for total beginners, built in JavaScript with web search allowed.
videos.prompt:
帮我用js制作一个视频，主题是：什么是Git
要深入浅出，让一个计算机0基础的人也能看得懂，然后要介绍一些常用指令的意思等等
要有声音的，然后是中文讲的
你可以用任何工具或者安装工具，可以联网检索
videos.prompt_en:
Help me make a video with js. The topic: What is Git
Explain it in simple terms so that someone with zero computer background can understand it, and also explain what some common commands mean, etc.
It should have sound, narrated in Chinese
You can use any tools or install tools, and you can search the web
techniques: chapter counter chip ('05/08 常用命令（一）') top-left as persistent progress
three-zone diagram (working dir / staging / repo) with file chips that move between zones on git add / commit
terminal window typing commands beside a definition card that glosses each command
branch graph that forks, adds commits on 'feature' and merges back with a 'you are here' marker
TTS-synced Chinese subtitle bar along the bottom
videos.summary_zh: 6 分 48 秒、中文配音的「什么是 Git」零基础科普。分章讲分布式、工作区 / 暂存区 / 仓库三区、常用命令的终端演示和分支合并图，底部配同步字幕。

vi.why: Sơ đồ ba vùng có các chip file di chuyển khi git add, git commit; cửa sổ terminal gõ lệnh đặt cạnh thẻ định nghĩa; đồ thị nhánh tách, thêm commit rồi gộp lại có dấu "bạn đang ở đây". Bộ đếm chương góc trên và phụ đề đồng bộ giọng đọc ở dưới.
vi.how: Hợp với video dạy công cụ lập trình cho người mới. Thay công cụ cần dạy, nêu đối tượng người xem, ngôn ngữ giọng đọc và danh sách lệnh hay tính năng cần giải thích.

videos.author: brainextends
videos.desc: An 18-second 1080p60 Spotify-themed product film, one-shotted from a spec with a per-second timeline, a fictional album cover and seek(t) rendering rules.
videos.prompt:
Create a complete, polished Spotify-themed motion graphics video from the following brief. This prompt is self-contained: no reference video or supplied assets are required.

<deliverables> An 18-second MP4 at 1920×1080 and true 60 fps, with music and subtle sound effects Complete editable source Build, render, inspect, and refine the animation before delivering it Do not stop at a storyboard, still images, or an implementation plan </deliverables>
<art_direction>
A premium music-product film presented inside a large, nearly black rounded rectangular stage
The stage occupies roughly 80% of the canvas width and 75% of its height, centered horizontally and slightly below the vertical center
Outside the stage, use a soft atmospheric green background: luminous emerald near the upper-left corner, deeper forest green toward the sides, fading to near-black at the bottom
Inside the stage:
Near-black background
White primary typography
Muted gray secondary text
Spotify green # 1ED760 for emphasis and controls
One clean sans-serif font, such as Geist or Inter
Consistent icon strokes and restrained shadows
Keep compositions compact and centered, with substantial negative space
Text should feel like music-product advertising, not oversized presentation headings
Do not add an outer caption, creator watermark, decorative footer, or progress counter
</art_direction>

<artwork> Create original square album artwork for a fictional track called “Glass Tides” by “AURA”
The hero cover is an abstract macro image of flowing pearlescent liquid silk and molten glass
Use pastel lavender, powder cyan, blush pink, champagne gold, and subtle mint
Include broad three-dimensional folds, realistic reflective highlights, delicate striations, and a prominent sweeping S-shaped fold
Fill the square edge to edge
No text, logo, or border on this hero artwork
Use this same artwork consistently throughout the film

Create additional designed playlist sleeves:
“Late Nights” in mustard yellow
“Good Energy” in pink
“Deep Focus” in blue
“Daily Mix 1”, “Daily Mix 2”, and “Daily Mix 3” in complementary colors

These should look like finished graphic-design covers, with bold typography and simple geometric motifs
</artwork>

<timeline> 0.0–0.6 seconds: A green Spotify icon grows smoothly into the center of the dark stage Give it a confident arrival with minimal overshoot
0.6–1.5 seconds:
The icon transitions into a small Spotify identity above two centered lines:
“Discover”
“new music”
The first line is white; the second is green
Reveal them with short masked vertical movements
1.5–2.4 seconds:
A stylized Spotify desktop interface rises into view
Show a slim sidebar, “Made for you”, three album cards, and small supporting rows
Use a subtle perspective tilt during the entrance, settling toward a frontal view
2.4–3.2 seconds:
Move closer to the three featured covers
Show “New for you” above them
Keep the artwork crisp, with short album titles beneath
A narrow rounded player bar now anchors the bottom of the stage
3.2–4.0 seconds:
The featured cards withdraw into a compact “Fresh finds” list
Reveal four song rows with a slight stagger
Each row contains a thumbnail, short track title, artist, and a small menu icon
4.0–4.9 seconds:
Transition into a horizontal strip of colorful playlist covers
Heading: “Every mood”
Supporting line: “Find what moves you”
The strip slides smoothly sideways, with edge cards partially cropped by the stage
4.9–5.8 seconds:
A compact search field appears
Type “Glass Tides”
Reveal one selected result beneath it, with the iridescent artwork, “AURA”, and a green play icon

5.8–6.6 seconds:
The selected artwork expands into a large centered cover
Reveal “Glass Tides” underneath, followed by “AURA” in green
Keep the player bar visible
6.6–7.5 seconds:
The same cover slides left
Track information appears on the right:
“Glass Tides”
“AURA”
“A new frequency”
Add a rounded green Play button
Coordinate the cover movement and text reveals
7.5–8.3 seconds:
A brief brand-color transformation fills the inner stage with green
The artwork contracts into a smaller centered tile
Place a small dark Spotify identity underneath
The player briefly recedes
8.3–9.8 seconds:
Return to the dark stage
The same artwork expands dramatically toward the camera, becoming oversized and cropped by the rounded stage
Restore the player at the bottom
Use controlled motion blur during the fastest part of the zoom

9.8–11.2 seconds:
The artwork clears into a centered typographic statement:
“Find your”
“rhythm”
Use white for the first line and green for the second
The player remains visible and stable beneath it
11.2–12.5 seconds:
Show “Made for your every day”
Three playlist sleeves enter with gentle perspective and small opposing tilts
They spread into six smaller sleeves across the stage
Supporting line: “Your sound, always evolving”

12.5–14.0 seconds:
The playlist layout transitions into four floating album covers
Include the iridescent hero artwork
Use restrained rotation, perspective, depth ordering, and overlap
Keep their movement coordinated rather than randomly floating
14.0–15.2 seconds:
The covers converge toward the center and fold around a green Spotify icon
The artwork withdraws as the icon becomes the focal point
Fade the player away
The Spotify icon must emerge from the same central position as the converging covers
15.2–18.0 seconds:
The icon moves slightly left and settles beside a large white “Spotify” wordmark
Keep the icon and letters separated throughout the movement
Reveal:
“Discover new music”
“every day”
The first line is white; the second is green
Hold the finished composition cleanly through the end
</timeline>
<persistent_player>
For most of the middle sequence, keep one narrow rounded player bar near the bottom of the inner stage
Include:
Small hero-art thumbnail
“Glass Tides” and “AURA”
Play and skip controls
A thin progress track
A small volume icon
Subdued dark translucent styling with a fine border
This recurring player connects the changing shots
It must remain visually secondary to the artwork
</persistent_player>

<motion_quality>
Match the energy of a tightly edited premium product film
Most visual ideas last approximately one second, but transitions remain smooth
Use continuous acceleration and deceleration
Favor critically damped springs or carefully tuned smooth easing
No repeated bouncing or large elastic overshoots
Preserve the hero artwork’s identity and position relationships through search, album detail, brand tile, and zoom
Use match-position transitions, coordinated scaling, masked reveals, and perspective
Outgoing titles must disappear before incoming titles occupy the same space
Avoid overlapping text, sudden camera resets, long blank intervals, and arbitrary full-frame crossfades
Clip every oversized cover and camera move cleanly to the rounded stage
No particles, shockwave rings, lens flares, camera shake, or unrelated stock footage
</motion_quality>

<audio> Create or select commercially usable electronic music around 120 BPM Use a clean pulse, warm bass, restrained melodic elements, and subtle transition accents Align important entrances, selections, zooms, and the logo reveal with musical events Keep effects quieter than the music No voiceover Do not use copyrighted commercial tracks without permission </audio>
<implementation_and_validation>
Build a deterministic animation driven by absolute time through an async window. seek(t) function
Every transform, opacity, mask, and UI state must be reproducible when seeking frames in any order
Do not depend on live timers, accumulated physics, or CSS transition state during export

Render true 60 fps with spatial antialiasing
Use 3–5 temporal subframe samples per output frame for restrained motion blur
Keep stationary text and artwork sharp
Inspect contact sheets and moving playback
Check the fast heading changes, artwork handoffs, zoom, cover convergence, and final wordmark spacing
Verify evenly spaced frame timestamps and the full 18-second duration
Fix visual defects before delivering the final MP4 and editable source
</implementation_and_validation>

titles.en: 35-second Chinese short drama with a twist

videos.author: AI_DVD6
videos.desc: A 35-second Chinese micro-drama: Opus proposes and picks the story, then coaches a beginner step by step through generating and editing the shots in Jianying (CapCut).
videos.prompt:
你现在不是普通小说作者。

你是一名同时懂：

* 中文短剧编剧
* 短视频留存机制
* AI 视频制作
* 低成本内容生产
* 商业化内容设计

的短剧主创。

我要做一个公开实验：

**挑战：一个人能不能依靠 Opus 5.5 + AI 视频工具，把一句故事创意做成一部真正有人愿意看完的 30～40 秒短剧。**

这个实验最终会公开：

* 完整制作过程
* 最终成片
* 总耗时
* AI 工具成本
* 人工参与程度

所以你的任务不是展示文学水平，而是帮我设计一个：

**好看、低成本、容易用 AI 做出来、适合中文社交媒体传播的商业短剧 Demo。**

## 一、制作硬限制

请严格遵守：

* 成片目标：30～40 秒
* 最佳目标：约 35 秒
* 主要人物：最多 2 人
* 次要人物：尽量没有
* 场景：优先 1 个，最多 2 个
* 总镜头：6～8 个
* 单镜头尽量 3～6 秒
* 开头 3 秒必须出现冲突、异常或强信息
* 避免复杂群众场面
* 避免追车、打斗、大规模动作戏
* 避免大量需要精准口型的长对白
* 避免频繁换服装、年龄、发型
* 避免复杂手部动作和物体交互
* 避免需要大量环境变化的剧情
* 尽量让主要人物在大部分镜头中保持同一套服装
* 尽量让大部分剧情发生在同一空间
* 故事必须适合 AI 图片 / AI 视频生成
* 优先提高人物、服装、场景的一致性
* 最终必须可以由一个人完成

## 二、内容目标

目标观众是中文互联网普通成年人。

故事必须同时满足：

1. 前 3 秒就出现明显冲突、异常或利益损失；
2. 8 秒内让观众明白“为什么我要继续看”；
3. 中途至少有一次信息升级；
4. 最后 8～10 秒出现明显反转、揭晓或情绪释放；
5. 不需要复杂背景知识也能看懂；
6. 看完以后最好会让人产生评论欲；
7. 题材优先靠近成年人真实欲望：

* 钱
* 工作
* 阶层
* 婚恋
* 面子
* 逆袭
* 欺骗
* 省钱
* 人性反转
8. 不要写成 AI 科技故事。AI 只是幕后制作工具，不是剧情主题。
9. 不要依赖旁白解释剧情，尽量让人物行为和短对白推动故事。
10. 不要为了反转故意写得不合常理。

## 三、特别考虑“商业短剧”

这不是文学比赛。

请优先考虑这种结构：

**一个非常容易理解的人物处境**
→
**迅速制造不公平、误会、羞辱、损失或欲望**
→
**冲突进一步升级**
→
**最后反转**

例如可以借鉴但不要机械照搬：

* 大家以为最穷的人其实……
* 看起来占便宜的人最后……
* 一个不起眼的决定让局面完全逆转
* 被轻视的人掌握了其他人不知道的信息
* 一个人为了省一笔小钱，最后付出更大代价
* 看似普通的陌生人，真实身份完全不同

不要使用已经被拍烂的：

* 霸道总裁亮身份
* 富豪装穷打脸
* 服务员其实是老板
* 穷小子突然继承百亿资产

除非你能给出明显不同的新意。

## 四、特别考虑 AI 制作成本

每个故事都要主动压低后期生成成本。

优先选择：

* 1 个固定室内场景
* 2 个固定人物
* 少走动
* 少复杂动作
* 少道具
* 少换镜头环境
* 少大幅度表情变化
* 少精准口型要求
* 可以通过特写、反应镜头、手机画面、账单、短信、文件等低成本视觉信息推动剧情

如果一个创意虽然好看，但需要很多人物、地点、动作或复杂镜头，请主动淘汰。

## 五、你第一阶段只做“选故事”

先不要写完整剧本，也不要写分镜 Prompt。

请先提出 **5 个完全不同的短剧创意**。

每个创意必须包含：

### 1. 一句话故事

用 20～40 字说清楚。

### 2. 开头 3 秒

具体发生什么。

### 3. 核心冲突

为什么观众会继续看。

### 4. 中途升级

大约在第 12～20 秒发生什么新信息。

### 5. 最终反转

最后 8～10 秒揭晓什么。

### 6. 为什么适合 AI 制作

从以下角度说明：

* 人物数量
* 场景数量
* 动作复杂度
* 人物一致性
* 背景一致性
* 口型难度

### 7. 商业潜力

这个题材以后可以延伸成什么：

* 短剧账号
* 剧情广告
* 小说改编
* 商业客户 Demo
* 系列内容
* 低成本样片
等。

### 8. 制作难度

1～5 星。

### 9. 预计 AI 视频镜头数

目标控制在 6～8 个。

### 10. 最大制作风险

例如：

* 人物一致性
* 动作生成
* 口型
* 道具交互
* 反转难以视觉化
等。

## 六、最后帮我做选择

在 5 个方案之后，请从以下 5 个角度比较：

* 最容易让普通观众看完
* 最容易用 AI 做好
* 最容易压低制作成本
* 最容易在 30～40 秒内讲清楚
* 最适合拿来证明“一人短剧工作流”

然后选出你认为最适合作为第一次实验的 **1 个方案**。

不要只告诉我“它最好”。

请明确说明：

* 为什么它比另外 4 个更适合第一次实验
* 它最大的剧情风险是什么
* 它最大的 AI 制作风险是什么
* 如果成片失败，最可能失败在哪一步

如果五个方案都不够好，请直接推翻重做，不要为了完成任务硬选。

## 七、输出文件

请在当前项目中创建：

`01_story_candidates.md`

把全部内容写进去。

先停在这里。

不要继续写：

* 完整剧本
* 分镜
* 图片 Prompt
* 视频 Prompt
* 配音方案

等我审核故事以后，再进入下一阶段。”

2️⃣ 第二步：制作阶段
第一步完成后，将以下提示词继续粘贴给它——

“接下来，请你不要只把剪映执行步骤写进文档里。
请你直接进入“新手陪练模式”，一步一步带我在剪映里把这部短剧做完。

默认我是一个几乎不会用剪映的小白，所以请严格遵守下面的方式指导我：

一、不要一次告诉我全部步骤
每次只告诉我“当前这一步”要做什么。
格式固定为：
当前目标
用一句话告诉我这一小步要完成什么。
我现在要点哪里
用最具体、最简单的话告诉我：
打开哪个功能
点哪个按钮
上传什么文件
粘贴哪一段 Prompt
需要填写什么参数
不要用“进入相关设置”“调整一下参数”这种模糊表达。
要尽量写成：
点击「AI视频」
→ 选择「图生视频」
→ 上传 shot_01.png
→ 把下面这段 Prompt 粘贴进去
→ 时长选择 5 秒
→ 其他参数先保持默认
如果你不确定我当前剪映版本里按钮叫什么，请告诉我你想实现的功能，并让我把当前界面截图发给你确认。

二、每完成一步，都先等我确认
不要自动跳到下一步。
每次你指导完后，请停下来，只问我：
“这一步完成了吗？如果完成了，把结果截图发我；如果报错，也把报错截图发我。”
等我回复后，你再判断下一步。

三、主动检查结果，不要默认生成成功
每个视频镜头生成完成后，请根据我发给你的截图或结果判断：
人脸有没有变形
人物有没有换脸
衣服有没有变化
场景有没有漂移
动作是否符合分镜
镜头是否过度夸张
有没有多余人物
手部动作有没有崩
文字有没有乱码
这一镜是否值得保留
如果结果不合格，不要让我直接进入下一镜。
请告诉我：
问题出在哪里
是应该修改 Prompt，还是重做首帧
给我一版修改后的 Prompt
再让我重新生成

四、优先帮我省时间和积分
每进入一个镜头之前，先判断：
这一镜真的需要 AI 视频生成吗？
如果：
静态图就能表达
剪映运镜就能解决
手机截图、转账记录、文字卡片就够用
请直接告诉我：
“这一镜不要烧视频积分，用静态图 + 剪映运镜更划算。”
只有确实需要人物动作、表情变化或镜头运动时，才让我使用图生视频。

五、所有 Prompt 都直接给我可复制版本
不要只告诉我“让人物轻微点头”。
要直接给我：
【复制到剪映的 Prompt】
……
这样我可以直接复制粘贴。
如果需要英文 Prompt，请直接给英文。
如果中文就够用，就用中文。
不要让我自己改写。

六、从第 1 镜开始，逐镜完成
请读取我们之前已经确定的：
最终剧本
分镜文件
人物设定
场景设定
每镜首帧
每镜视频 Prompt
然后从第 1 镜开始。
每完成一镜后，记录状态：
Shot 01：完成 / 重做
Shot 02：待处理
Shot 03：待处理
……
让我随时知道现在做到哪里。

七、全部镜头完成后，再带我剪辑
等所有镜头素材都确认合格以后，再继续一步一步指导我：
导入所有素材
按分镜顺序排列
调整每段时长
添加配音
添加字幕
添加音效
添加 BGM
必要的转场
音量平衡
最终导出
仍然一次只教一步。
不要一次把 10 步全部丢给我。

八、最后做一次成片检查
在导出前，请带我检查：
总时长是否符合 30～40 秒
开头 3 秒是否足够抓人
中间有没有拖沓
反转是否清楚
字幕是否看得清
人声和 BGM 是否打架
人物是否前后一致
有没有明显 AI 穿帮
有没有可以删掉的镜头
有没有必要重做某一镜
如果整体已经达到“可以发布”的水平，就明确告诉我：
“可以导出了。”
如果还不行，请只告诉我最值得修改的 1～3 个问题，不要无限追求完美。
现在，请先读取之前已经完成的剧本、分镜和素材文件。
然后只告诉我：
剪映里的第一步应该做什么。
videos.prompt_en:
You are not an ordinary fiction writer now.

You are a short-drama lead creator who understands all of the following at once:

* Chinese short-drama screenwriting
* Short-video retention mechanics
* AI video production
* Low-cost content production
* Commercial content design

I am running a public experiment:

**Challenge: can one person, relying on Opus 5.5 + AI video tools, turn a one-line story idea into a 30–40 second short drama that people actually want to watch to the end?**

The experiment will eventually make public:

* The full production process
* The final cut
* Total time spent
* AI tool costs
* How much human involvement there was

So your task is not to show off literary skill, but to help me design:

**A commercial short-drama demo that is good to watch, low-cost, easy to make with AI, and suited to spreading on Chinese social media.**

## 1. Hard production limits

Follow these strictly:

* Target length of the final cut: 30–40 seconds
* Best target: about 35 seconds
* Main characters: 2 at most
* Secondary characters: ideally none
* Locations: 1 preferred, 2 at most
* Total shots: 6–8
* Each shot ideally 3–6 seconds
* A conflict, anomaly or strong piece of information must appear in the first 3 seconds
* Avoid complex crowd scenes
* Avoid car chases, fights and large-scale action
* Avoid long dialogue that needs precise lip sync
* Avoid frequent changes of costume, age or hairstyle
* Avoid complex hand movements and object interactions
* Avoid plots that need lots of environment changes
* Try to keep the main characters in the same outfit in most shots
* Try to keep most of the plot in the same space
* The story must suit AI image / AI video generation
* Prioritize consistency of characters, costumes and setting
* It must ultimately be doable by one person

## 2. Content goals

The target audience is ordinary adults on the Chinese internet.

The story must satisfy all of these:

1. An obvious conflict, anomaly or loss appears within the first 3 seconds;
2. Within 8 seconds the viewer understands "why should I keep watching";
3. At least one escalation of information midway;
4. An obvious twist, reveal or emotional release in the last 8–10 seconds;
5. It can be understood without complex background knowledge;
6. Ideally it makes people want to comment after watching;
7. The subject should stay close to real adult desires:

* Money
* Work
* Class
* Love and marriage
* Face (pride)
* Comebacks
* Deception
* Saving money
* Twists of human nature
8. Don't write an AI tech story. AI is only the behind-the-scenes production tool, not the theme of the plot.
9. Don't rely on voice-over to explain the plot; let the characters' actions and short lines drive the story as much as possible.
10. Don't make it illogical just for the sake of a twist.

## 3. Think specifically about "commercial short drama"

This is not a literary competition.

Prioritize this kind of structure:

**A character situation that is very easy to understand**
→
**Quickly create unfairness, misunderstanding, humiliation, loss or desire**
→
**The conflict escalates further**
→
**A twist at the end**

For example, you may borrow from these, but don't copy them mechanically:

* The person everyone thought was the poorest actually…
* The person who seemed to be getting the better deal ends up…
* An inconspicuous decision completely reverses the situation
* The person being looked down on holds information nobody else knows
* Someone tries to save a small sum and ends up paying a bigger price
* A seemingly ordinary stranger has a completely different true identity

Don't use these worn-out tropes:

* The domineering CEO reveals his identity
* The rich man pretends to be poor and then shames everyone
* The waiter is actually the boss
* The poor guy suddenly inherits tens of billions

Unless you can offer something clearly new.

## 4. Think specifically about AI production cost

Every story should actively push down the cost of generation in post-production.

Prefer:

* 1 fixed indoor location
* 2 fixed characters
* Little walking around
* Few complex actions
* Few props
* Few changes of shot environment
* Few large changes in facial expression
* Few precise lip-sync requirements
* Moving the plot forward with low-cost visual information such as close-ups, reaction shots, phone screens, bills, text messages and documents

If an idea looks good but needs many characters, locations, actions or complex shots, eliminate it yourself.

## 5. In the first stage you only "pick the story"

Don't write the full script yet, and don't write storyboard prompts.

First propose **5 completely different short-drama ideas**.

Each idea must include:

### 1. One-line story

State it clearly in 20–40 characters.

### 2. The first 3 seconds

What exactly happens.

### 3. Core conflict

Why viewers will keep watching.

### 4. Midpoint escalation

What new information arrives around seconds 12–20.

### 5. Final twist

What is revealed in the last 8–10 seconds.

### 6. Why it suits AI production

Explain from these angles:

* Number of characters
* Number of locations
* Action complexity
* Character consistency
* Background consistency
* Lip-sync difficulty

### 7. Commercial potential

What this subject could later extend into:

* A short-drama account
* Story-driven ads
* Novel adaptation
* Demos for commercial clients
* Series content
* Low-cost sample films
etc.

### 8. Production difficulty

1–5 stars.

### 9. Estimated number of AI video shots

Target 6–8.

### 10. Biggest production risk

For example:

* Character consistency
* Motion generation
* Lip sync
* Prop interaction
* The twist is hard to show visually
etc.

## 6. Finally, help me choose

After the 5 proposals, compare them from these 5 angles:

* Easiest for ordinary viewers to watch to the end
* Easiest to do well with AI
* Easiest to keep production cost low
* Easiest to tell clearly within 30–40 seconds
* Best suited to proving the "one-person short-drama workflow"

Then pick the **1 proposal** you think is best for the first experiment.

Don't just tell me "it's the best".

State clearly:

* Why it suits the first experiment better than the other 4
* What its biggest story risk is
* What its biggest AI production risk is
* If the final cut fails, which step it is most likely to fail at

If none of the five proposals is good enough, scrap them and start over; don't force a choice just to finish the task.

## 7. Output file

Please create in the current project:

`01_story_candidates.md`

Write everything into it.

Stop here for now.

Don't go on to write:

* The full script
* The storyboard
* Image prompts
* Video prompts
* The voice-over plan

Wait until I have reviewed the stories, then move on to the next stage.”

2️⃣ Step 2: production stage
After step 1 is done, paste the following prompt to it as well —

“Next, please don't just write the Jianying steps into the document.
Go straight into "beginner coaching mode" and walk me step by step through finishing this short drama in Jianying.

Assume by default that I am a beginner who can barely use Jianying, so guide me strictly in the following way:

1. Don't tell me all the steps at once
Each time, only tell me what to do in "the current step".
Use this fixed format:
Current goal
Tell me in one sentence what this small step should accomplish.
Where do I click now
Tell me in the most concrete, simplest words:
which feature to open
which button to click
which file to upload
which Prompt to paste
which parameters to fill in
Don't use vague phrases like "go into the relevant settings" or "adjust the parameters a bit".
Write it as much as possible like this:
Click 「AI视频」
→ choose 「图生视频」
→ upload shot_01.png
→ paste the Prompt below
→ set the duration to 5 seconds
→ leave the other parameters at their defaults for now
If you are not sure what a button is called in my current version of Jianying, tell me the function you want to achieve and ask me to send a screenshot of the current screen to confirm.

2. After each step, wait for my confirmation first
Don't jump to the next step automatically.
Each time you have guided me, stop and only ask me:
"Is this step done? If it is, send me a screenshot of the result; if there is an error, send me a screenshot of the error too."
After I reply, you decide on the next step.

3. Actively check the results; don't assume generation succeeded
After each video shot is generated, judge from the screenshot or result I send you:
Is the face deformed
Has the character's face changed
Has the clothing changed
Has the setting drifted
Does the action match the storyboard
Is the shot overly exaggerated
Are there extra people
Have the hand movements broken
Is any text garbled
Is this shot worth keeping
If the result is not acceptable, don't let me move straight on to the next shot.
Tell me:
where the problem is
whether to change the Prompt or redo the first frame
give me a revised Prompt
then have me regenerate

4. Prioritize saving my time and credits
Before each shot, first judge:
Does this shot really need AI video generation?
If:
a still image can express it
Jianying's camera moves can handle it
a phone screenshot, transfer record or text card is enough
tell me directly:
"Don't burn video credits on this shot; a still image + a Jianying camera move is more cost-effective."
Only have me use image-to-video when character movement, a change of expression or camera movement is really needed.

5. Give me every Prompt as a ready-to-copy version
Don't just tell me "have the character nod slightly".
Give me directly:
【Prompt to copy into Jianying】
……
so I can copy and paste it directly.
If an English Prompt is needed, give it in English.
If Chinese is enough, use Chinese.
Don't make me rewrite it myself.

6. Starting from shot 1, finish shot by shot
Please read what we have already settled:
Final script
Storyboard file
Character settings
Setting descriptions
The first frame of each shot
The video Prompt for each shot
Then start from shot 1.
After each shot is done, record its status:
Shot 01: done / redo
Shot 02: pending
Shot 03: pending
……
so I always know where we are.

7. Only after all shots are done, guide me through editing
Once all the shot footage has been confirmed as acceptable, keep guiding me step by step:
Import all footage
Arrange it in storyboard order
Adjust the length of each clip
Add voice-over
Add subtitles
Add sound effects
Add BGM
Necessary transitions
Volume balance
Final export
Still teach only one step at a time.
Don't throw all 10 steps at me at once.

8. Finally, do one check of the finished cut
Before exporting, walk me through checking:
Whether the total length fits 30–40 seconds
Whether the first 3 seconds grab attention enough
Whether anything drags in the middle
Whether the twist is clear
Whether the subtitles are legible
Whether the voice and the BGM clash
Whether the characters stay consistent throughout
Whether there are obvious AI giveaways
Whether any shot can be cut
Whether any shot needs to be redone
If the whole thing has reached a "ready to publish" level, tell me clearly:
"Ready to export."
If not, only tell me the 1–3 issues most worth fixing; don't chase perfection endlessly.
Now, please first read the script, storyboard and asset files that are already done.
Then only tell me:
What the first step in Jianying should be.
videos.title_vi: Phim ngắn 35 giây tiếng Trung có cú twist

vi.what: Phim ngắn 35 giây tiếng Trung: Opus đề xuất và chọn câu chuyện, rồi kèm một người mới từng bước tạo cảnh và dựng trong Jianying (CapCut).
vi.why: Prompt giai đoạn một là bản yêu cầu sản xuất chặt: tối đa 2 nhân vật, 1 đến 2 bối cảnh, 6 đến 8 cảnh, xung đột trong 3 giây đầu, cú twist ở 8 đến 10 giây cuối; bắt đưa ra 5 phương án, so sánh rồi chọn một và dừng chờ duyệt. Giai đoạn hai chuyển sang chế độ kèm cặp: mỗi lần một bước, chờ ảnh chụp màn hình, kiểm tra lỗi mặt, tay, trang phục và cân nhắc bước nào không cần tốn credit tạo video.
vi.how: Hợp với người muốn tự làm phim ngắn hay quảng cáo dạng kịch bằng công cụ AI tạo video. Thay đối tượng khán giả và nhóm đề tài trong mục nội dung, đổi phần hướng dẫn CapCut sang công cụ bạn dùng.

titles.en: Motion designer showreel from a one-line greeting
titles.zh: 一句问候生成的动效作品集

videos.author: zheke
videos.desc: A 15-second motion design piece from a one-line prompt that simply asks Opus 5.5 to show off as a motion designer.
videos.prompt: Hello Opus 5.5 show me what an incredible motion designer you are.
techniques: 「I CAN + 动词」重复句式，每个动词用对应动画原理演出（SQUASH 被压扁、OVERSHOOT 回弹过冲、STRETCH 拉伸拖影、SNAP 碎裂）
橙色圆点从句点变成弹球再回到 5.5 的小数点，全片唯一贯穿元素
玻璃水滴在 BEND LIGHT 字上滚过并真实折射文字
橙色粗线划掉 'AFTER EFFECTS' 再砸出 'JUST CODE.'
背景色每拍硬切（米白→蓝→黑→橙）配全局 RGB 色散
videos.summary_zh: 15 秒方形动态字体秀：「I'M OPUS 5.5 / I CAN 压扁、过冲、渲染、折光、拉伸」每个动词都用动画演出来，最后「划掉 After Effects，JUST CODE.」
videos.title_vi: Showreel chữ chuyển động từ một câu chào

vi.what: Đoạn 15 giây khổ vuông, lặp câu I CAN kèm một động từ, và mỗi động từ được diễn bằng đúng nguyên lý hoạt hình của nó như bị nén, vượt đích, kéo giãn. Kết bằng cảnh gạch chữ After Effects và đập ra JUST CODE.
vi.why: Prompt chỉ là một câu chào, nhưng kết quả cho thấy ý tưởng chữ tự diễn nghĩa của mình rất hiệu quả. Một chấm cam xuyên suốt, từ dấu chấm thành quả bóng rồi thành dấu thập phân của 5.5, giữ mạch cho cả đoạn.
vi.how: Dùng khi muốn đoạn kinetic type khoe kỹ năng hoặc tính năng. Nếu muốn kiểm soát hơn, ghi rõ danh sách động từ và yêu cầu mỗi từ tự diễn nghĩa.

titles.en: Morphing journey from creature to cosmos
titles.zh: 从小生物到宇宙的变形之旅

videos.author: leo_xiaolei
videos.desc: A 30-second hand-drawn-style Canvas film where each scene morphs into the next, from creature to neurons, prism, sunflower, galaxy, black hole and earthrise, following a reference video.
videos.prompt:
你现在是 Claude Opus 5.5，作为资深创意编程工程师（Creative Coder）、动态设计师（Motion Designer）与前端动画工程师。
你的任务是复现我所提供的参考视频中的视觉语言、节奏律动、转场逻辑以及整体氛围质感。
核心目标不是做一个常规网页。
核心目标是使用代码构建一部全程序化生成、具备电影质感且能够自动播放的动画短片。
最终成片应呈现出精致的手作动态设计（Motion Design）质感，而非一堆网页组件的拼接。
1. 项目目标
基于参考视频，构建一部时长 25–30 秒的程序化动画短片。
整段动画需串联多个视觉意象：
可爱角色
→ 神经元 / 电流脉冲结构
→ 三棱镜与彩虹色散
→ 几何色彩构型
→ 向日葵
→ 螺旋星系
→ 黑洞
→ 宇宙隧道
→ 地球升起（地出）
→ 回归角色
最核心的要求：
绝对不要做成互相割裂的幻灯片切换。
每一个场景都必须自然地在视觉上形变过渡至下一个场景。
运用手段包括：
形状渐变（Morphing）
粒子过渡（Particle transitions）
缩放过渡（Scale transitions）
镜头推进（Camera pushes）
径向展开过渡（Radial transitions）
溶解渗透（Dissolves）
实体到实体的几何形变（Object-to-object transformations）
色彩连续性（Color continuity）
运动动量延续（Motion continuity）
整部动画应当呈现为一次连贯流动的“意识流”。
2. 技术栈
技术选用：
Vite
TypeScript
HTML Canvas 2D
requestAnimationFrame
确定性时间轴系统（Deterministic timeline system）
程序化图形生成（Procedural graphics）
可复用的场景模块
仅在对以下视觉实现有实质性帮助时，才允许引入 Three.js：
星系
黑洞
地球
镜头景深
切勿无端引入重型依赖库。
除非有不可替代的理由，否则避免使用 React。
这是一项动画短片工程，而非 UI 应用。
3. 画布参数设定
设计基准分辨率：1920 × 1080
画面宽高比：16:9
目标帧率：30 FPS
动画必须支持自适应响应式缩放，同时严格保持 16:9 的设计坐标系。
必须正确处理 devicePixelRatio，确保动画在高分屏（Retina / High-DPI）上清晰锐利。
4. 视觉风格
参考范本具有插画风科普动画的质感。
目标视觉特征：
手绘质感
微带瑕疵的不规则形状
细微的线条抖动感（Line wobble）
柔和的肌理纹理
有机自然而非机械生硬的几何体
灵动俏皮却不失高级感
干净通透的构图
清晰鲜明的剪影造型
克制但极具表现力的配色方案
避免出现：
泛滥的通用 SaaS 插画风
扁平化企业图标感
冗余的 UI 界面元素
拟真写实风格（Photorealism）
赛博朋克美学
过度的霓虹光污染
千篇一律的 AI 生成式渐变
带有素材库库感的素材
5. 配色导向
主背景色：
暖奶油色 / 米白色
例如：#F2E8CF
深色宇宙场景：
深海蓝
暗紫色
近乎纯黑的夜空蓝
点缀高光色：
橙色
向日葵黄
紫罗兰
青色
洋红
柔红
克制且克制地使用渐变色。
色彩在不同场景间应保持过渡流动，而非突兀瞬变。
6. 肌理与质感
生成细腻的程序化纸张质感。
可选实现路径：
低透明度的随机噪点
背景亮度的细微不均
轻微的颗粒感叠加层（Grain overlay）
质感需清晰可感知，但绝不能喧宾夺主。
禁止加载体积庞大的纸张实拍贴图资源。
尽量全部采用程序化计算生成。
7. 动画时间轴
搭建统一的中控时间轴系统。
时间参考规划：
0.0s – 4.0s：角色登场
4.0s – 7.5s：神经元 / 电流脉冲网络
7.5s – 10.0s：三棱镜 / 光线色散
10.0s – 13.5s：色彩几何 → 向日葵
13.5s – 17.0s：向日葵 → 螺旋星系
17.0s – 20.5s：星系 → 黑洞
20.5s – 23.5s：黑洞 → 宇宙隧道 / 光柱
23.5s – 27.0s：地出（Earth Rise）
27.0s – 30.0s：回归角色
以上时间分配非死板硬性规定，若有助于增强视觉韵律与节奏感，可按需微调。
8. 场景 01 — 角色
时长： 约 0–4 秒。
绘制一个简洁可爱的矩形橙色小生物。
特征：
圆角矩形身体
小短腿
极简的面部特征
轻微不对称的手绘轮廓线条
亲和灵动的性格表现
动画细节：
小生物从画外缓缓走向画面中央。
行走动画需包含：
身体起伏颠簸（Bounce）
双腿交替摆动
轻微的身体倾角晃动
细腻的挤压与拉伸（Squash and stretch）
避免机械僵硬的匀速运动。
充分应用缓动曲线（Easing）与次级跟随动作（Secondary motion）。
场景尾声：
小生物对身旁浮现的事物产生反应。
该反应动作将直接触发下一阶段的转场。
9. 角色 → 神经元转场
不要生硬剪辑。
过渡方案：
角色身旁亮起一个微小的光点。
光点逐渐扩散放大。
细小的分支线开始从中抽枝蔓延。
镜头向前推近。
在逐渐膨胀铺展的网络对比下，角色身形显现得越来越小。
最终，神经元脉络结构铺满整个屏幕。
10. 场景 02 — 神经网络
时长： 约 4–7.5 秒。
具象化一种介于以下元素之间的视觉形态：
神经元 / 生物电 / 分支生物形态 / 闪电脉冲。
使用程序化分形/分支算法生成。
节点伴随脉冲呼吸。
信号流沿各个分支游走传导。
要求：
动态电脉冲流动
有机自然的分支几何体
微小的飞溅火花粒子
线条粗细富于节奏变化
兼具可控的随机感
切勿做成千篇一律的机器学习拓扑网络拓扑图。
它应当充满生物活力与能量感。
11. 神经元 → 三棱镜转场
选中其中一条极为明亮的电脉冲分支。
让这条分支逐渐拉直伸展。
流动其中的能量凝聚为一束纯净的白色光束。
神经网络的其余部分逐渐消隐在暗色背景中。
白光光束横穿画面。
精准投射射入一座三角形三棱镜。
12. 场景 03 — 三棱镜
时长： 约 7.5–10 秒。
绘制一个手绘透明感的三棱镜。
白光自一侧射入。
经三棱镜折射并色散为：
红、橙、黄、绿、青、蓝、紫。
不要只画死板固定的彩虹线。
需制作动态效果：
光束到达的冲击动态
三棱镜受光泛出的辉光
色散铺开的过程
细微的折射光线游移
柔和的光晕泛光（Bloom）
展开的光谱将作为承接后续画面的关键转场媒介。
13. 三棱镜 → 色彩几何
折射出的彩虹光束发生弯曲。
逐步转化为同心圆弧。
圆弧相互嵌套，化作多层旋转的同心圆环。
镜头向视觉中心推近。
三棱镜自然消隐退出视野。
14. 场景 04 — 色彩光环
时长： 约 10–11.5 秒。
构建层层嵌套的彩色同心圆环。
运动方式：
缓慢旋转
正反方向交错旋转
微弱的呼吸式缩放
有机微动的抖动摆动（Wobble）
圆环线条需带有轻微的手作不完美质感。
避免数学上绝对冷硬工整的圆周。
15. 光环 → 向日葵
缓慢改变圆环的几何拓扑结构。
外侧圆环渐变分离为独立的花瓣。
中心圆环转化为密布的向日葵葵花籽花盘。
黄色逐渐占据视觉主导。
整个演化形变过程需清晰可见。
避免使用透明度淡入淡出（Crossfade）的偷懒手法。
让观者能够直观看到一种几何形态如何演变为另一种生命形态。
16. 场景 05 — 向日葵
时长： 约 11.5–14 秒。
生成一朵风格化的程序化向日葵。
视觉构成：
明亮的金黄花瓣
温暖橙黄的花心
深色螺旋状排列的花籽
隐约可见的纤细花茎或植物形态
动画表现：
花瓣舒展盛放
轻柔的生命呼吸感
整体微微旋转
籽粒螺旋排列运动
若条件允许，葵花籽可采用斐波那契数列 / 黄金角分布算法生成。
17. 向日葵 → 螺旋星系
这将是整部短片视觉张力最强的转场之一。
向日葵中心加速旋转。
外围花瓣逐渐剥离脱散。
每一片花瓣解构为一颗发光的星尘粒子。
中心的花籽阵列向外螺旋扩张。
色调柔和渐次推移：
黄色
→ 橙色
→ 紫色
→ 深蓝
整朵向日葵无缝蜕变为一座旋转的旋涡星系。
切忌使用简单的画面叠化淡出。
18. 场景 06 — 螺旋星系
时长： 约 14–17 秒。
构建一座程序化生成的旋涡星系。
要求：
在性能允许的前提下布置成千上万个微型粒子
采用对数螺线 / 旋臂分布规律
极度明亮致密的星系核心
错落点缀的背景繁星
呈现深邃的空间纵深感
镜头缓慢向前推进
整体缓慢转动
粒子需拥有丰富的透明度梯次与大小半径。
避免机械匀质的死板星点分布。
使用带有固定种子（Seeded Random）的随机算法，确保每次播放呈现的画面细节完全一致。
19. 星系 → 黑洞
星系中心区域的自转角速度逐渐加快。
中央区域急剧暗沉塌缩。
周围粒子开始加速环绕运转。
沿切线方向将运动的粒子微微拉伸拖尾。
中央的纯黑视界向外扩张。
整个星系逐步转化为狂暴的吸积盘。
20. 场景 07 — 黑洞
时长： 约 17–20.5 秒。
构建一座风格化的黑洞。
要素：
吞噬一切的纯黑球体核心
炽热发光的吸积盘
橙金交织的内层强光
紫蓝晕染的外围辉光
沿弯曲引力轨迹运动的粒子流
可选实现：做近似引力透镜效果的视觉扭曲。
无需苛求物理层面上严格精确的广义相对论模拟。
以呈现上乘的视觉美感为第一优先级。
镜头向视界面缓慢平稳推近。
21. 黑洞 → 宇宙隧道
镜头彻底穿透坠入中心黑暗。
吸积盘受透视拉伸拉长为同心光环。
周围星尘被径向拉伸成向外散射的放射线。
营造出跃入时空隧道的穿梭沉浸感。
22. 场景 08 — 宇宙隧道
时长： 约 20.5–23.5 秒。
构建由同心发光环或粒子光环构成的深邃通道。
镜头高速向前飞行穿梭。
重点注意：
严禁使用老套庸俗的科幻“超空间跃迁（Hyperspace）”特效。
严格维系短片一贯的插画手绘风味。
临近该段尾声：
通道中央骤然凝聚为一束笔直刺目的白色垂直光柱。
23. 隧道 → 地球转场
这道垂直光柱横向延展放平。
其底边下沉拉平，化作一条地平线。
地平线下方的大片幽黑转化为静谧的月球表面。
一抹深邃纯净的幽蓝辉光在地平线后方缓缓漫溢升腾。
24. 场景 09 — 地出（Earth Rise）
时长： 约 23.5–27 秒。
呈现一幅电影质感的大幅画面：一颗蔚蓝星球自幽暗的月球地平线后缓缓升起。
地球细节包含：
泛着光晕的蔚蓝大气层
高度概括简化的云气流动
提炼简化的陆地轮廓
细腻柔和的外缘辉光
除非绝对必要，否则严禁使用外部实拍 NASA 图片贴图。
优先采用纯代码程序化 / 矢量风格化方式渲染。
月表前景保持绝大部分深邃剪影。
匹配极度舒缓沉稳的运镜节奏。
此处应作为整部影片中最空灵宁静的高光时刻。
25. 地球 → 角色转场
镜头快速向地球表面的一处极亮星斑推近。
那抹幽蓝辉光凝聚为一颗极小的球形光点。
光球进一步缩小。
背景底色褪去深黑，无缝褪回最初温润的暖奶油色。
光点轻盈落在了最初那只小生物的身旁。
镜头缓缓拉远回撤。
26. 尾声终幕
画面回归最初那只橙色小生物。
小生物转过头，注视着身旁落下的微光小点。
反应动作建议：
眨一眨眼睛
露出微笑
