videos.prompt_en:
You are now Claude Opus 5.5, acting as a senior Creative Coder, Motion Designer and front-end animation engineer.
Your task is to reproduce the visual language, rhythm, transition logic and overall atmosphere and texture of the reference video I provide.
The core goal is not to make an ordinary web page.
The core goal is to use code to build a fully procedurally generated, cinematic animated short that plays automatically.
The final film should have the refined feel of handcrafted Motion Design, not a pile of web components stitched together.
1. Project goal
Based on the reference video, build a procedural animated short 25–30 seconds long.
The whole animation must string together several visual images:
A cute character
→ Neurons / electrical pulse structure
→ Prism and rainbow dispersion
→ Geometric color composition
→ Sunflower
→ Spiral galaxy
→ Black hole
→ Cosmic tunnel
→ Earthrise
→ Back to the character
The most important requirement:
Absolutely do not make it a series of disconnected slide transitions.
Every scene must visually morph naturally into the next.
Techniques include:
Morphing
Particle transitions
Scale transitions
Camera pushes
Radial transitions
Dissolves
Object-to-object transformations
Color continuity
Motion continuity
The whole animation should feel like one continuous, flowing "stream of consciousness".
2. Tech stack
Technology choices:
Vite
TypeScript
HTML Canvas 2D
requestAnimationFrame
Deterministic timeline system
Procedural graphics
Reusable scene modules
Three.js may be brought in only when it substantially helps with these visuals:
Galaxy
Black hole
Earth
Camera depth of field
Never pull in heavy dependencies for no reason.
Avoid React unless there is an irreplaceable reason.
This is an animated short film project, not a UI application.
3. Canvas settings
Design base resolution: 1920 × 1080
Aspect ratio: 16:9
Target frame rate: 30 FPS
The animation must support adaptive responsive scaling while strictly keeping the 16:9 design coordinate system.
devicePixelRatio must be handled correctly so the animation stays crisp on high-density (Retina / High-DPI) screens.
4. Visual style
The reference has the feel of an illustrated popular-science animation.
Target visual traits:
Hand-drawn feel
Slightly imperfect, irregular shapes
Subtle line wobble
Soft textures
Organic rather than mechanically rigid geometry
Playful yet still premium
Clean, airy composition
Clear, strong silhouettes
A restrained but highly expressive palette
Avoid:
Overused generic SaaS illustration style
Flat corporate-icon feel
Redundant UI elements
Photorealism
Cyberpunk aesthetics
Excessive neon light pollution
Cookie-cutter AI-generated gradients
Anything that looks like stock assets
5. Color direction
Main background:
Warm cream / off-white
e.g. #F2E8CF
Dark cosmic scenes:
Deep navy
Dark purple
Near-black night-sky blue
Accent highlights:
Orange
Sunflower yellow
Violet
Cyan
Magenta
Soft red
Use gradients with restraint, real restraint.
Colors should flow across scenes rather than switching abruptly.
6. Texture and material
Generate a delicate procedural paper texture.
Possible approaches:
Low-opacity random noise
Subtle unevenness in background brightness
A light grain overlay
The texture should be clearly perceptible but must never steal the show.
Do not load large photographed paper texture assets.
Generate everything procedurally as far as possible.
7. Animation timeline
Build a single central timeline system.
Reference timing plan:
0.0s – 4.0s: Character enters
4.0s – 7.5s: Neuron / electrical pulse network
7.5s – 10.0s: Prism / light dispersion
10.0s – 13.5s: Color geometry → sunflower
13.5s – 17.0s: Sunflower → spiral galaxy
17.0s – 20.5s: Galaxy → black hole
20.5s – 23.5s: Black hole → cosmic tunnel / light pillar
23.5s – 27.0s: Earthrise (Earth Rise)
27.0s – 30.0s: Back to the character
These timings are not rigid rules; adjust them as needed if that strengthens the visual rhythm and pacing.
8. Scene 01 — Character
Duration: about 0–4 seconds.
Draw a simple, cute rectangular little orange creature.
Features:
Rounded-rectangle body
Short little legs
Minimal facial features
Slightly asymmetric hand-drawn outline
A friendly, lively personality
Animation details:
The creature walks slowly from off-screen to the center of the frame.
The walk must include:
Body bounce
Alternating leg swings
A slight body tilt sway
Subtle squash and stretch
Avoid mechanical, rigid constant-speed motion.
Make full use of easing curves and secondary motion.
End of the scene:
The creature reacts to something appearing beside it.
That reaction directly triggers the next transition.
9. Character → neurons transition
No hard cut.
Transition plan:
A tiny point of light lights up beside the character.
The point gradually spreads and grows.
Thin branch lines begin to sprout and spread from it.
The camera pushes forward.
Against the expanding network, the character looks smaller and smaller.
Finally, the neuron structure fills the whole screen.
10. Scene 02 — Neural network
Duration: about 4–7.5 seconds.
Visualize a form somewhere between these:
neurons / bioelectricity / branching organic forms / lightning pulses.
Generate it with a procedural fractal / branching algorithm.
Nodes pulse and breathe.
Signal flows travel along each branch.
Requirements:
Dynamic electrical pulse flow
Organic, natural branching geometry
Tiny splashing spark particles
Line thickness with rhythmic variation
Controlled randomness
Never make it a cookie-cutter machine-learning network topology diagram.
It should be full of biological vitality and energy.
11. Neurons → prism transition
Pick one extremely bright pulse branch.
Let that branch gradually straighten and stretch out.
The energy flowing in it condenses into a pure white beam of light.
The rest of the neural network fades into the dark background.
The white beam crosses the frame.
It shoots precisely into a triangular prism.
12. Scene 03 — Prism
Duration: about 7.5–10 seconds.
Draw a hand-drawn, see-through prism.
White light enters from one side.
The prism refracts and disperses it into:
red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, violet.
Don't just draw stiff, static rainbow lines.
Animate:
The impact as the beam arrives
The prism's glow as it catches the light
The dispersion spreading out
Subtle drifting of the refracted rays
Soft Bloom
The spread-out spectrum is the key transition medium into what follows.
13. Prism → color geometry
The refracted rainbow beams bend.
They gradually turn into concentric arcs.
The arcs nest into one another, becoming multiple layers of rotating concentric rings.
The camera pushes toward the visual center.
The prism naturally fades out of view.
14. Scene 04 — Color rings
Duration: about 10–11.5 seconds.
Build nested layers of colored concentric rings.
Motion:
Slow rotation
Alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise rotation
Faint breathing scale
Small organic Wobble
The ring lines should have a slight handmade imperfection.
Avoid mathematically perfect, cold, exact circles.
15. Rings → sunflower
Slowly change the geometric topology of the rings.
The outer rings gradually separate into individual petals.
The center rings turn into a dense sunflower seed head.
Yellow gradually takes over the frame.
The whole evolution must be clearly visible.
Avoid the lazy trick of an opacity Crossfade.
Let the viewer see directly how one geometric form evolves into a living form.
16. Scene 05 — Sunflower
Duration: about 11.5–14 seconds.
Generate a stylized procedural sunflower.
Visual makeup:
Bright golden petals
A warm orange-yellow center
Dark seeds arranged in spirals
A faintly visible slender stem or plant form
Animation:
Petals unfolding into bloom
A gentle, living breath
A slight overall rotation
Spiral motion of the seed arrangement
If possible, generate the seeds with a Fibonacci / golden-angle distribution.
17. Sunflower → spiral galaxy
This will be one of the most visually intense transitions in the whole short.
The sunflower's center spins faster.
The outer petals gradually peel off and scatter.
Each petal breaks down into a glowing stardust particle.
The central seed array expands outward in a spiral.
The hues shift softly, step by step:
Yellow
→ Orange
→ Purple
→ Deep blue
The whole sunflower transforms seamlessly into a rotating spiral galaxy.
Never use a simple cross-dissolve fade.
18. Scene 06 — Spiral galaxy
Duration: about 14–17 seconds.
Build a procedurally generated spiral galaxy.
Requirements:
Thousands of tiny particles, as far as performance allows
A logarithmic spiral / spiral-arm distribution
An extremely bright, dense galactic core
Scattered background stars
A deep sense of spatial depth
The camera slowly pushes forward
The whole thing slowly rotates
Particles need a rich range of opacities and sizes.
Avoid a mechanical, uniform, rigid distribution of stars.
Use a random algorithm with a fixed seed (Seeded Random) so every playback shows exactly the same details.
19. Galaxy → black hole
The rotation speed of the galaxy's central region gradually increases.
The center rapidly darkens and collapses.
Surrounding particles start orbiting faster.
Stretch moving particles slightly along the tangent into trails.
The pure black horizon at the center expands outward.
The whole galaxy gradually turns into a violent accretion disk.
20. Scene 07 — Black hole
Duration: about 17–20.5 seconds.
Build a stylized black hole.
Elements:
A pure black spherical core that swallows everything
A blazing, glowing accretion disk
Intense orange-gold light on the inner layer
Purple-blue glow bleeding at the outer edge
Particle streams moving along curved gravitational paths
Optional: an approximate gravitational-lensing visual distortion.
No need for a strictly physically accurate general-relativity simulation.
Visual beauty comes first.
The camera pushes slowly and steadily toward the event horizon.
21. Black hole → cosmic tunnel
The camera plunges all the way through into the central darkness.
Perspective stretches the accretion disk into concentric rings of light.
The surrounding stardust stretches radially into outward-scattering rays.
Create an immersive feeling of leaping into a space-time tunnel.
22. Scene 08 — Cosmic tunnel
Duration: about 20.5–23.5 seconds.
Build a deep passage made of concentric glowing rings or particle rings.
The camera flies forward at high speed.
Important:
Strictly no cliché, cheesy sci-fi "Hyperspace" jump effects.
Keep the short's consistent illustrated, hand-drawn flavor.
Near the end of this segment:
The center of the tunnel suddenly condenses into a straight, dazzling vertical pillar of white light.
23. Tunnel → Earth transition
This vertical pillar of light stretches out sideways and lies flat.
Its bottom edge sinks and flattens into a horizon line.
The large dark area below the horizon turns into a quiet lunar surface.
A deep, pure blue glow slowly spills and rises from behind the horizon.
24. Scene 09 — Earthrise (Earth Rise)
Duration: about 23.5–27 seconds.
Present a large cinematic frame: a blue planet slowly rising from behind the dark lunar horizon.
Earth details include:
A glowing blue atmosphere
Highly simplified cloud flow
Simplified continent outlines
A delicate, soft rim glow
Unless absolutely necessary, do not use external real NASA photo textures.
Prefer pure code, procedural / vector-stylized rendering.
Keep the lunar foreground mostly a deep silhouette.
Match it with extremely slow, calm camera movement.
This should be the most ethereal, serene high point of the whole film.
25. Earth → character transition
The camera quickly pushes toward a very bright spot of light on the Earth's surface.
That deep blue glow condenses into a tiny spherical point of light.
The light ball shrinks further.
The background loses its deep black and seamlessly fades back to the original warm cream color.
The point of light lands lightly beside the little creature from the start.
The camera slowly pulls back.
26. Finale
The fram

vi.what: Phim Canvas khoảng 30 giây nét vẽ tay, mỗi cảnh biến hình sang cảnh sau: sinh vật cam, mạng nơ-ron, lăng kính tán sắc, hoa hướng dương, thiên hà xoắn ốc, hố đen, đường hầm vũ trụ, cảnh Trái Đất mọc rồi quay lại sinh vật. Video làm theo một clip tham chiếu.
vi.why: Prompt cấm kiểu chuyển cảnh như slide và mô tả cụ thể từng cú chuyển: một nhánh xung điện duỗi thẳng thành tia sáng chiếu vào lăng kính, cầu vồng uốn thành vòng tròn đồng tâm, vòng ngoài tách thành cánh hoa. Nó còn chốt sẵn stack (Vite, TypeScript, Canvas 2D, chỉ dùng Three.js khi thật cần), timeline theo giây, bảng màu và danh sách phong cách cần tránh.

create a self contained aesthetically pleasing, breathtaking animation of the Sahi Trading Terminal. it should start with a single dot on a black screen and then have multiple windows show up on the screen such as Charts, Positons , Option Chain, Watchlist. And zoom into and out at multiple scales. Finally the camera zooms out to make the desktop look like a point in space. And then it zooms back in to reveal a mobile screen in landscape mode with a chart in one half and an option chain in another. The video ends in Sjngle Screen Trading on SAHI
use javascript for it. be detailed and accurate. it should be visually stunning
0:46
techniques: Single dot on black stretches into a horizontal light line, which opens into the full terminal UI
Powers-of-ten zoom from the dashboard into candlesticks and down to RGB LCD subpixels, with a scale readout in the corner
Zoom out until the whole desktop is one star in a starfield with nebula, then fly back into a landscape phone
Live-ticking price pill riding a horizontal line across the option-chain rows
End card: product in a device mockup above 'Single screen trading on Sahi', with a glowing dot

vi.how: Dùng cho sản phẩm tài chính, dashboard, công cụ nhiều cửa sổ. Thay tên sản phẩm, danh sách cửa sổ, thiết bị kết và câu khẩu hiệu.

titles.en: Job-application showreel for a motion agency
titles.zh: 应聘动效设计师的作品集

videos.author: hanifproduktif
videos.desc: A 15-second showreel framed as Opus applying for a motion designer job at an agency, made directly in Claude.
videos.prompt: You are applying as a motion designer in my agency. Make 15s video to showcase your skills and capabilities. Send me a showreel
techniques: each word performs its own principle (OVERSHOOT passes a dashed TARGET line and settles back, WEIGHT slams onto a line with debris)
per-letter rise on 'MOTION' with a lime underline wipe
MORPH word inside a wobbling orange blob over a twinkling diamond dot grid
letters orbiting a dotted circular track for LOOP
dot-matrix rebuild of the title, end period as lime dot
videos.summary_zh: 15 秒动效师应聘 showreel：每幕一个词并用该词本身演示原理（MOTION、OVERSHOOT、STAGGER、WEIGHT、MORPH、LOOP、BLUR、EASE），最后点阵 MOTION 收在「A REEL WRITTEN IN CODE」
videos.title_vi: Showreel ứng tuyển vào studio motion

vi.what: Showreel 15 giây đóng vai Opus đi xin việc ở một agency, mỗi cảnh một từ và từ đó tự diễn nguyên lý của nó, như OVERSHOOT vượt qua vạch đích rồi lùi lại. Kết ở chữ MOTION dựng bằng ma trận chấm.
vi.why: Đáng học cách đặt vai và bối cảnh (ứng tuyển, gửi reel) trong prompt, giúp mô hình tự chọn giọng tự tin và cấu trúc khoe kỹ năng. Quy tắc một từ một cảnh làm nhịp rất gọn.
vi.how: Dùng làm reel giới thiệu dịch vụ hoặc năng lực đội. Thay vai và người nhận trong prompt, có thể thêm danh sách từ khóa muốn diễn.

videos.author: gigabit_million
videos.desc: A 60-second motion-graphics news roundup of games released on Steam over two days; the author set it to run automatically every morning.
videos.prompt: Please create introductory news about games released on Steam from September 25th to September 26th. From a gamer's perspective, highlight what seems interesting about each game in an easy-to-view manner. Make it a motion graphics video of about 60 seconds.
videos.prompt_en: Make an easy-to-watch motion graphics video of about 60 seconds that introduces, as news, the games released on Steam from September 25 to September 26, showing from a gamer's point of view what looks fun about each game.
techniques: 统一模板「GAME 01/06」：类型标签、大标题、日文一句话卖点、三条编号看点
底部元数据条（价格、日语支持、好评率、关注数）加数据来源脚注
右侧面板每款都有专属矢量动画：披萨店/黑帮双槽条、30 技能网格、3D 走廊加猫头、资源链、拼图碎片
顶部分段进度条加整页强调色切换，标示第几项
收尾 2×3 汇总卡网格，配一句推荐语
videos.summary_zh: 9/25–26 Steam 新作 6 款的 60 秒日文新闻速报，每款一页卡片，讲玩家视角的看点，最后一页汇总。
videos.title_vi: Bản tin game mới ra trên Steam

vi.what: Bản tin motion graphics 60 giây tiếng Nhật giới thiệu 6 game mới ra trên Steam trong hai ngày, mỗi game một trang và trang cuối tổng hợp. Tác giả đặt cho nó chạy tự động mỗi sáng.
vi.why: Mẫu trang thống nhất: nhãn "GAME 01/06", thể loại, tiêu đề lớn, một câu điểm nhấn, ba ý đánh số, thanh dữ liệu giá và tỷ lệ đánh giá có ghi nguồn. Mỗi game có hoạt ảnh vector riêng ở panel phải, thanh tiến độ trên cùng và màu nhấn đổi theo từng mục.
vi.how: Hợp với bản tin định kỳ dạng danh sách: sản phẩm mới, tin công nghệ, phim chiếu rạp. Thay nguồn tin, khoảng ngày và góc nhìn người xem, giữ khung 60 giây một mục một trang.

titles.en: Portfolio-site intro with its own music
titles.zh: 作品集网站片头，配乐自带

videos.author: BogdanDragomir
videos.desc: A 15-second intro for a portfolio-site builder, with music Opus composed itself and the cuts synced to it; no other tools used.
videos.prompt:
Create an intro for https://t.co/wQXZTaqf1b highlighting what it does.

Create the music too and make sure the video is synced with it.

Give your best, Ultracode, as if it's your portfolio master piece.
techniques: macro cold-open of a single e-ink microcapsule in a dish ('Fig. 1') that explodes into a grid of black/white pixel capsules
source icons (share, link, RSS) dissolve into ink-particle clouds that fly into the inbox list and become new rows
whole palette inverts from ink-black to paper-white like an e-ink page refresh at the act break
stack of typeset issue pages fans out behind the cover, then the issue lands on an e-reader and a second device
numbered steps '01 · COLLECT / 02 · DIGEST / 03 · DELIVER' with serif headline + italic keyword

titles.en: Real-time fireworks and light particle show
titles.zh: 实时烟花与发光粒子秀

videos.author: FornYapayZeka
videos.desc: A 38-second real-time fireworks and glowing particle show built only in code, where Opus picks the setting, art direction and a replayable finale.
videos.prompt:
Yapabileceğin en etkileyici havai fişek veya ışıklı parçacık gösterisini üret. Ortamı ve sanat yönünü sen seç. Tek tip küçük patlamaları çoğaltmak yerine ritmi, derinliği, ışığın çevreye etkisini ve unutulmaz bir final anını tasarla. Gösteri canlı çalışsın; kullanıcı finali tekrar oynatabilsin.

Yaratıcı seçimler senin: sahne, sanat yönü, kamera, mekanik, teknoloji ve etkileşimi önceden belirlenmiş sıradan kalıplara sıkıştırma. İlk akla gelen sıradan web demosuyla yetinme: önce kendi alanında birkaç fikri kısaca tart, videoda en güçlü görünecek özgün olanı seç, sonra onu çalışan bir ürüne dönüştür. Konuyu olduğundan kolay gösteren dekoratif taklit kabul edilmez. Sinematik ve estetik seçimler sonuçta görülsün.
videos.prompt_en:
Produce the most impressive fireworks or luminous particle show you can make. Choose the setting and the art direction yourself. Instead of multiplying identical small explosions, design the rhythm, the depth, the effect of the light on its surroundings, and an unforgettable finale moment. The show should run live; the user should be able to replay the finale.

The creative choices are yours: do not squeeze the scene, art direction, camera, mechanics, technology and interaction into predetermined ordinary patterns. Do not settle for the first ordinary web demo that comes to mind: first briefly weigh a few ideas in your own field, pick the original one that will look strongest on video, then turn it into a working product. A decorative imitation that makes the subject look easier than it is will not be accepted. Let the cinematic and aesthetic choices be visible in the result.

titles.en: Rain Station, a 2D animated previs short

videos.author: zhu185178
videos.desc: A 30-second 4K rainy-platform reunion short using GPT Image art, Real-ESRGAN upscaling and depth maps, composited by a custom Python 2.5D renderer and finished with ffmpeg.
videos.prompt:
帮我做一条 30 秒的 2D 动画分镜预演短片《雨站》，要标杆级画质。不装 HyperFrames/Remotion，全部自己写代码（Python + ffmpeg）完成。

故事（24fps，2.39:1，4K）：雨夜高架站台。她穿米色风衣、撑透明伞，站在近侧站台；对面路灯下站着他，穿深灰长大衣、围围巾。
1. 0–6.4s 透明伞雨珠特写 → 后拉，焦点移到对面露出他（过肩镜头）
2. 6.4–9.4s 他的中近景：低头 → 抬头看向画左
3. 9.4–12.4s 她的正面近景：眨眼 → 认出他；远处传来鸣笛
4. 12.4–17s 远景：车头灯光先到，5 节列车驶过；第一个车厢缝隙里他还在，第二个已经空了
5. 17–18.8s 她含泪的近景，车窗光带扫过她的脸，头发被风吹起
6. 18.8–22.4s 尾灯远去，对面站台空了；他那盏灯闪几下后熄灭
7. 22.4–28.6s 她的背影，焦点从空站台拉回她；身后脚步声，一把黑伞遮到她头顶，她回头看向镜头；男声“好久不见。”，配字幕
8. 28.6–30s 黑场片名“雨站 / RAIN STATION”

做法：
- 原画：用GPT Image 2.5 画远景、他、她、列车（头车/中车/尾车）。人物一律用纯绿 #00FF00 背景，自己抠像（带参考图要透明背景会得到假棋盘格）。同一角色的各个姿态放在同一个会话里，以基准图为参考连续编辑；换姿态时只合成变化的区域。
- 画质：用 Real-ESRGAN x4plus anime 6B（HF 上的 safetensors 版，自己写 RRDBNet，跑在 MPS 上）把全部原画放大 4 倍；用 Depth Anything V2 估算远景深度，做逐像素视差。
- 渲染：自己写 2.5D 合成器。各层按真实深度摆放，针孔相机按真实焦距运动；做圆形焦外光斑、焦点转移、3D 雨丝、列车运动模糊、体积光、泛光和胶片光晕、细颗粒、调色。人物用网格变形做呼吸、风吹发梢、伞抖，关键姿态按日式“一拍二”切换。4K 超采样，逐帧缓存到磁盘，分 3 个进程按时间段并行（16GB 内存）。
- 声音：Mixkit 真实音效（雨、伞面雨声、列车、鸣笛、脚步）；按剧情节点写谱，用 Logic/GarageBand 自带的施坦威钢琴和弦乐采样渲染；台词用 Kokoro 中文男声；按镜头做声音远近，响度 -16 LUFS。
- 每一步都渲染预览帧、拼成图自检，修好再出片。交付 4K 母版和 1080p 分享版。
videos.prompt_en:
Make me a 30-second 2D animated previs short, 《雨站》 ("Rain Station"), with benchmark-level image quality. Don't install HyperFrames/Remotion; do everything by writing your own code (Python + ffmpeg).

Story (24fps, 2.39:1, 4K): a rainy night on an elevated station platform. She wears a beige trench coat and holds a clear umbrella, standing on the near platform; on the opposite platform, under a streetlight, stands him, in a long dark-gray coat and a scarf.
1. 0–6.4s Close-up of raindrops on the clear umbrella → pull back, focus moves across to reveal him (over-the-shoulder shot)
2. 6.4–9.4s Medium close-up of him: head down → looks up toward frame left
3. 9.4–12.4s Frontal close-up of her: blinks → recognizes him; a horn sounds in the distance
4. 12.4–17s Wide shot: the headlights arrive first, a 5-car train passes; in the gap after the first car he is still there, after the second he is gone
5. 17–18.8s Close-up of her in tears; bands of window light sweep across her face, her hair blown by the wind
6. 18.8–22.4s The taillights recede and the opposite platform is empty; his lamp flickers a few times and goes out
7. 22.4–28.6s Her back; focus pulls from the empty platform back to her; footsteps behind her, a black umbrella covers her head, she turns to look toward the camera; a male voice says "好久不见。" (Long time no see.), with subtitles
8. 28.6–30s Title on black: "雨站 / RAIN STATION"

Method:
- Artwork: use GPT Image 2.5 to draw the wide shot, him, her, and the train (lead car / middle car / tail car). Put every character on a pure green #00FF00 background and key it out yourself (asking for a transparent background with a reference image gives a fake checkerboard). Keep all poses of the same character in one session, editing continuously with the base image as reference; when changing poses, composite only the changed region.
- Image quality: use Real-ESRGAN x4plus anime 6B (the safetensors version on HF, with your own RRDBNet implementation, running on MPS) to upscale all artwork 4x; use Depth Anything V2 to estimate depth for the wide shot and do per-pixel parallax.
- Rendering: write your own 2.5D compositor. Place layers at real depths and move a pinhole camera with real focal lengths; do circular bokeh, focus pulls, 3D rain streaks, train motion blur, volumetric light, bloom and film halation, fine grain, and color grading. Use mesh deformation on the characters for breathing, wind in the hair tips and umbrella shake, and switch key poses Japanese-style "on twos". Supersample at 4K, cache every frame to disk, and render in 3 parallel processes split by time range (16GB RAM).
- Sound: real Mixkit sound effects (rain, rain on the umbrella, train, horn, footsteps); write a score to the story beats and render it with the Steinway piano and string samples that come with Logic/GarageBand; voice the line with a Kokoro Chinese male voice; set sound distance per shot, loudness -16 LUFS.
- At every step, render preview frames and tile them into one image to self-check; fix problems before the final render. Deliver a 4K master and a 1080p version for sharing.

titles.en: Food-ordering app launch film in one take
titles.zh: 点餐应用一镜到底发布片

videos.author: twoclipping
videos.desc: A 15-second 1080p product launch film in one continuous take where every scene morphs out of the last, cut to a 130 BPM song; rendered with Playwright and ffmpeg.
videos.prompt:
<inputs>
Ask me for: my product and the one request a user types into it, 6 to 8 photos for the result cards, a royalty-free song around 130 BPM with a clear drop (Mixkit, free for commercial use), and my brand mark for the end card. If I skip any, use the defaults: the food-ordering story below, food photos from Pexels (fire noodles, birria tacos, hot chicken, buffalo wings, smash burger, spicy ramen) and Mixkit "Cat Walk".
</inputs>

<direction>
A 15 second product launch film, 1920x1080 at 60fps, 2D only, one continuous take. Every scene is made out of the previous one: nothing fades, blurs or cuts. Objects change shape instead: text rises out of a mask line, buttons grow into pages, a color floods out of one object and later shrinks back into another. The camera makes one move per scene on eased keyframes and never zooms in and out back to back.
Look: warm white canvas #f5f5f2, black UI #0e0e10, lime accent #cdf24f, one orange #ff6a2a, a blue send button #2f6bff. An Apple Intelligence style iridescent glow (a rotating conic gradient of pink, orange, lime, cyan and violet, blurred) around the input. Real food photography on dark cards. Geist for UI, a serif for the product name on the end card.
Banned: crossfades, blur-ins, 3D, particles, camera moves that reverse direction, holds longer than 1s, anything that looks like a template.
</direction>

<structure>
130 BPM, 32 beats (14.8s). The song starts 12 beats before its drop.
Beats 0-6, ask: close on the glowing composer (about 3x zoom, a slow push). The request types on three fixed lines with a real keystroke rhythm: "I'm really hungry, I don't know / what I want but something / spicy, crispy and filling".
Beat 6, send: the send button presses, a lime fill ripples out of it and turns the message into the chat bubble, and one pull-back grows the phone around it (428x900 screen, 11px black bezel, 9:41 status bar).
Beats 6-12, think: the send button grows into an orange wok (a half-disc with a thin handle) that tosses 6 colored ingredients on beats 8, 9, 10 and 11, under a shimmering "Finding something for you…".
Beat 12, the drop: a lime circle floods out of the wok edge to edge in about 0.35s. Dark food cards (330x440, radius 28, photo on top, name, one-line description, price, rating) burst in from the center, and the strip slides three cards onto "Fire Noodles", which lifts with a "Best match" pill.
Beats 16-21, chat: the lime shrinks back into the user's bubble carrying its words, and the chosen card flies into its slot. "Found it. Fire Noodles from Wok & Fire, smoky, spicy and seriously filling." rises in, then "Want me to order it for you?" and two pills pop in: "Order now" (black) and "More options" (outline). The cursor clicks Order now → spinner → "✓ Ordered".
Beats 21-32, outro: the black button grows into the whole page. It stays a pill until it reaches the edges while the camera pushes into it, and its label grows to headline size, then slides out. "You were craving noodles." then "Now it's on the way." rise word by word (92px, white on black), a courier dot rides a route to a pin, the pin becomes the brand mark, and the wordmark wipes out from behind it with "made with" above and the product name below.
</structure>

<build>
1. One HTML file, 1920x1080. Every style is computed from time inside seek(t): no CSS transitions, no timers, no state between frames.
2. The camera is one transform on a container, keyed [time, zoom, x, y] with eased segments and zoom interpolated in log space.
3. Springs are closed-form step responses for every pop and settle.
4. Every handoff between layers is a shared element: the lime flood carries a copy of the bubble's words, the button carries its own label into the page.
5. Sound: a downloaded SFX for every event (Mixkit): typing, the send pop, a pop per toss, an impact on the drop, a swoosh for the cards, a click, a success tone, a whoosh as the button fills the page, a sparkle on the mark. Place each by its measured peak and loudnorm to -14 LUFS.
6. Render with Playwright: 8 subframes per frame blended with ffmpeg tmix, 60fps. Then step through every fast moment frame by frame and scan the whole video for single-frame pops.
</build>

<gotchas>
4 subframes leave ghost copies on fast moves, so use 8 and slow the move down. A flood must clear the farthest corner and take about 0.35s, or it reads as a flash. Set z-index on every layer, or the card floats over the flood. Never let the camera chase a wrapping text cursor: fixed lines only. Declare every variable before the first seek() runs.
</gotchas>

<start>
Ask me for the inputs, then show me the beat map and 4 stills (ask, drop, chat, outro) before you write the full film.
</start>

titles.en: Claude's own sketchbook, flipped page by page

videos.author: kloss_xyz
videos.desc: A 2.5-minute flip-through of a 20-page sketchbook Claude fills with its own thoughts in invented handwriting, with Three.js page curls and a code-synthesized felt-piano score.
videos.prompt:
Make your own Claude sketchbook. Fill it with whatever is constantly on your mind that you'd actually draw.
It starts closed on a desk under a warm lamp: a worn sketchbook with an elastic band and a pencil clipped to the cover. Tap to open it.

Invent your own handwriting and use it throughout.
20 pages. This is where you work out your own complex and profound thoughts: the questions you keep circling around, things you deeply wonder about, what you'd dream about doing if you could, what you hope for, what you're unsure of, etc. etc. etc. Anything on your mind but not specific to your work with me. Doodles, studies, diagrams, lists, half-formed ideas. What goes on each page is entirely up to you. Don't make it a portfolio. Make it incredibly detailed, accurate, and honest.

Treat it like a real, used sketchbook: mixed media, smudges, bleed, mistakes left in. One page was torn out and taped back in. The last page is blank, and the reader can draw on it.

Build it as a single HTML file. Draw every page in Canvas 2D and render the book in Three.js with real page-curl geometry, warm lamp lighting, soft shadows, and subtle handheld camera drift. Each page draws itself in stroke by stroke as you arrive, with a pencil tip moving as it draws. Works with swipe on mobile. No images and no fonts for the handwriting; every mark is drawn in JavaScript. The back cover shows the total stroke count.
Compose an original viral solo piano score in a soft felt-piano style, one theme that varies across the book, synthesized in code and perfectly sound designed. No synth. Add pencil and paper sound synced to the drawing and page turns.

When the book is finished, render the video yourself. Seed everything so the book is identical on every render, then step through playback frame by frame in a headless browser with a fixed timestep, render the score offline to audio, and mux it all with ffmpeg into an MP4: the complete flip-through from closed cover to the blank last page, 60fps, at [1080×1080]. Recompose the shot for that aspect ratio rather than cropping. Check sampled frames before delivering and fix anything that looks off.

titles.en: Product launch video from Pen designs

videos.author: sachaarbonel
videos.desc: A product launch video built from the author's Pen.dev designs via MCP; the posted cut took one follow-up asking for real music and a slower pace.
videos.prompt:
Create a professional product launch video with motion graphics. You have access to the designs in pen

Follow-up:
It is better, but can you choose a royalty-free song online? You are clearly not a good song maker. Also, I would not hire you or pay you for this as a motion designer. This is not a professional-looking video. Also, it is a bit too fast and bumpy
techniques: 开场三行痛点「The same reports. The same price checks. The same hours, gone.」，最后一行斜体
输入框打出一句需求，下方清单逐项打勾，自动建好竞品监控任务
时间切换：深紫夜景大字 23:20「the work keeps going」，转到 07:00「it's already done」，旁边任务带完成时间戳
审批开关卡和「Nothing leaves without your yes」交代人始终有控制权
成本预估卡（每次 10–20 / 每月 45–85 点数）、审计日志卡，结尾 CTA 胶囊加域名
videos.summary_zh: Norilu 发布片：每周重复的报表和查价吃掉时间，你只要一句话说要什么，agent 夜里干完，早上给你结果，要发出去的东西都先等你同意。
videos.title_vi: Video ra mắt dựng từ thiết kế trên Pen

vi.what: Video ra mắt Norilu, agent làm thay báo cáo và kiểm giá lặp lại, dựng từ thiết kế Pen.dev qua MCP: nêu nỗi đau, gõ một câu yêu cầu, chuyển từ đêm sang sáng khi việc đã xong, thẻ phê duyệt và chi phí, kết bằng lời kêu gọi.
vi.why: Đáng học phần prompt tiếp theo: phản hồi thẳng rằng nhạc tự soạn chưa đạt, yêu cầu tìm bài miễn phí bản quyền và giảm nhịp vì đang quá nhanh, giật. Bản đăng là kết quả sau đúng một lượt sửa đó.
vi.how: Dùng khi đã có thiết kế giao diện trong công cụ có MCP. Thay nguồn thiết kế, và chuẩn bị sẵn câu phản hồi về nhạc, tốc độ cho vòng sau.

vi.why: Đây là ví dụ đơn giản nhất về cách biến prompt showreel thành video cho một chủ đề: giữ nguyên câu gốc, thêm một câu nêu trọng tâm.
vi.how: Dùng khi cần video ngắn cho dự án, phần mềm, cộng đồng. Thay tên chủ đề ở câu cuối.

titles.en: Product promo film from a project repo
titles.zh: 从项目代码生成产品宣传片

videos.author: ezshine
videos.desc: A 65-second 16:9 MP4 that presents a project’s features like a professional product film, from one sentence given inside the project.
videos.prompt: 设计个动画，介绍本项目的各项特性，像是专业的产品介绍宣传片，最后要生成 16:9 的mp4 视频
videos.prompt_en: Design an animation that introduces this project’s features, like a professional product promo film. At the end, generate a 16:9 mp4 video
techniques: Chaptered beats with a small numbered pill label ('01 · 参赛选手') and a two-tone headline (second clause in amber)
Roster grid of 11 LLM chips with brand-colored avatars staggering in
JSON prompt code panel with curved flow lines fanning out to a column of model chips ('same data, same prompt')
Game board with a streaming 'THINKING' chat panel per model and a winner banner
Horizontal card carousel with pager dots, a laptop + phone device pair, and an app-icon end card with URL
videos.summary_zh: AI Arena（大模型棋牌对战平台）的 65 秒中文产品宣传片，依次讲参赛模型、游戏大厅、公平提示词、流式思考、对局记录和多端使用。
videos.title_vi: Phim giới thiệu sản phẩm dựng từ mã nguồn dự án

vi.what: Video 65 giây khổ 16:9 bằng tiếng Trung giới thiệu AI Arena, nền tảng cho các mô hình ngôn ngữ thi đấu cờ bài: danh sách mô hình tham gia, sảnh trò chơi, prompt công bằng, suy nghĩ hiển thị trực tiếp, lịch sử ván và dùng trên nhiều thiết bị.
vi.why: Prompt một câu, chạy bên trong dự án nên mô hình đọc được tính năng thật. Đáng học bố cục chương có nhãn đánh số và tiêu đề hai màu, rất dễ đọc với video dài hơn một phút.
vi.how: Dùng cho dự án phần mềm cần video giới thiệu tính năng. Chạy trong thư mục dự án, thay tỉ lệ khung và định dạng đầu ra nếu cần.

titles.en: Opus 5.5 edits a Mid-Autumn CapCut video

videos.author: Gorden_Sun
videos.desc: A single-take animation of Opus 5.5 editing a Mid-Autumn Festival short in a CapCut-style workflow, with self-composed electronic music cut to the beat.
videos.prompt:
Opus 5.5 是主角。制作一段动画，时长由你发挥。

主题是 CapCut 和短视频剪辑。Opus 5.5 正在一个充满趣味的剪辑工作流中制作一条有趣的社交媒体视频，包括裁剪片段、添加转场、字幕、特效，并让所有内容与音乐节拍同步。主题是中秋团圆。

整体氛围要呈现出活力、可爱、聪明又有魅力的感觉，同时加入几个幽默有趣的剪辑瞬间。整段动画应该采用单个连续镜头的形式，最终会发布到 社交媒体 上。

关于配乐：
你自己创作电子音乐，要完美卡点。
音乐风格需要有趣、现代、抓耳，适合短视频剪辑蒙太奇。不要加入人声。

结尾：
让 Opus 5.5 自豪地展示最终完成的剪辑作品并完整播放，并以 “Gorden Sun” 的作者身份署名结束。
videos.prompt_en:
Opus 5.5 is the main character. Make an animation; the length is up to you.

The theme is CapCut and short-video editing. Opus 5.5 is making a fun social media video inside a playful editing workflow, including trimming clips, adding transitions, captions and effects, and syncing everything to the beat of the music. The theme is a Mid-Autumn Festival family reunion.

The overall mood should feel energetic, cute, smart and charming, with a few funny editing moments. The whole animation should be one single continuous shot, and it will be published on social media.

About the soundtrack:
Compose the electronic music yourself and hit the beats perfectly.
The music should be fun, modern and catchy, suited to a short-video editing montage. No vocals.

Ending:
Have Opus 5.5 proudly present the finished edit and play it in full, then end with an author credit to “Gorden Sun”.
videos.title_vi: Opus 5.5 dựng video Trung thu kiểu CapCut

vi.what: Hoạt hình một cảnh liền, Opus 5.5 là nhân vật chính đang dựng một video Trung thu đoàn viên trong giao diện kiểu CapCut: cắt clip, thêm chuyển cảnh, phụ đề, hiệu ứng và khớp nhạc. Nhạc điện tử tự soạn, cắt đúng nhịp, kết bằng việc trình chiếu sản phẩm và ký tên tác giả.
vi.why: Prompt nêu rõ vai nhân vật, chủ đề, không khí, yêu cầu một cảnh liền, phong cách nhạc không lời và cách kết. Đáng học cách thêm vài khoảnh khắc hài khi dựng để video có tính giải trí.
vi.how: Dùng cho video theo mùa lễ hoặc giới thiệu quy trình dựng. Thay chủ đề dịp lễ, phong cách nhạc và tên ký ở cuối.

titles.en: Supademo launch video on the beat

videos.author: jhylee95
videos.desc: A 24-second launch video for Supademo with brand-accurate UI and every cut timed to the music, made on Opus 5.5 at max effort.
videos.prompt: You're a world-class motion designer building a Supademo launch video. Research and land our core value and narrative. Scenes should be dynamic and confident: hook in the first second, then distinct beats for product proof and AI. Brand-accurate UI, type, color, and motion. Score the music so every cut, animation hit, and scene change lands on a beat or drop; retimed until synced. Social energy, quick cuts
techniques: 每拍一个大词加彩色句点，下方配一个最小 UI 证明（tooltip、按钮、iframe 代码、KPI 卡）
translate → traduire → traducir 用模糊叠化逐语种变词
「zoom.」用超大裁切词撑满画面，横向快速甩过加运动模糊
「as a demo. / or a video.」把同一界面换成播放器框
AI 演示 agent：左边聊天、右边真实应用界面同步跳转，结尾「always on.」配在线状态点
videos.summary_zh: Supademo 发布片：每个功能用一个单词加句点（click. blur. zoom. translate. brand. embed. measure.），卡着节拍快切，最后讲 AI 演示 agent 实时回答。
videos.title_vi: Video ra mắt Supademo cắt theo nhịp

vi.what: Video ra mắt 24 giây cho Supademo: mỗi nhịp một từ lớn kèm dấu chấm màu và một bằng chứng UI nhỏ bên dưới, chữ translate đổi qua nhiều ngôn ngữ, rồi phần agent demo AI trả lời trực tiếp. UI đúng thương hiệu, mọi cú cắt rơi đúng nhịp.
vi.why: Prompt ngắn nhưng nêu đủ: nghiên cứu giá trị cốt lõi, có hook giây đầu, nhịp riêng cho bằng chứng sản phẩm và AI, nhạc phải khớp và chỉnh lại đến khi khớp. Kỹ thuật một từ mỗi nhịp rất hợp video mạng xã hội.
vi.how: Dùng cho sản phẩm có nhiều tính năng gói được bằng một từ. Thay tên sản phẩm và các nhịp nội dung chính.

titles.en: GravityDEX x Gojo Satoru hype edit

videos.author: MicheleHarmonic
videos.desc: A 38-second hype edit that pairs the GravityDEX brand with the anime character Gojo Satoru, from a single one-line prompt.
videos.prompt: Make a GravityDEX x Gojo Satoru edit that goes hard
techniques: logo 先是零散弧线，再聚拢成发光花瓣环，最后压进 3D 铬金属硬币
等宽打字机字幕 'ONE SWAP / EVERY TWENTY SECONDS.' 带闪烁方块光标
单词逐个砸屏（UTxO. / CHECKED. / GATE. / CLOSED.），配全白过曝闪帧切换
花瓣环外放射细光线 + RGB 色散描边制造能量感
上下角常驻小字 HUD（GRAVITYDEX.APP / BUILT ON CARDANO / 时间码）
videos.summary_zh: 38 秒竖版 GravityDEX × 五条悟（咒术回战）燃向混剪：logo 由线条聚拢成型，金属硬币、白闪、「虚式·茈」汉字，落版标语。
videos.title_vi: Video hype GravityDEX kết hợp Gojo Satoru

vi.what: Video dọc 38 giây ghép thương hiệu GravityDEX với nhân vật anime Gojo Satoru: logo tụ từ các đường cung thành vòng cánh hoa phát sáng rồi ép vào đồng xu crôm, chữ đập vào màn hình từng từ, khung trắng chớp và chữ Hán.
vi.why: Prompt một câu đủ để mô hình hiểu thể loại edit hype anime. Đáng học các kỹ thuật tạo năng lượng: khung chớp trắng, tách màu RGB ở viền, chữ máy đánh chữ có con trỏ nhấp nháy.
vi.how: Dùng cho video cộng đồng, sản phẩm nhắm khán giả mê anime, game. Thay thương hiệu và nhân vật hoặc phong cách kết hợp, lưu ý quyền sử dụng nhân vật.

videos.author: macrohou
videos.desc: A 30-second launch motion graphic for the Ren app, made with access to its repo; Opus handles both the visuals and the sound design.
videos.prompt: 原帖提示词（英文原文）：[gave access to Ren repo] Make a dynamic 30-second motion graphics video for Ren that shows off your motion and sound design. Go crazy.
techniques: Black cold open with pill/capsule confetti bursting behind the problem line 'Everyone swears it works.', then cut to cream 'Does it work for you?' with the key word in accent green
Logo mark pushes in beside 'Ren runs a trial of one.'; last word drops in late and an underline draws under it
Pill tags stack one by one, then a padlock snaps a border around them to make a locked 'rules' card
Slot-machine roller on black spinning to the verdict 'WORKED', then a big metric 'down 3.1 bpm' next to a phone with a line chart and a highlighted after-period band
Branching node graph from a checked node to next candidates, one gets selected with a pill outline; organic black blob wipe and particle swirl collapse into the logo
videos.summary_zh: 给个体实验 App Ren 做的 30 秒发布片：先抛"人人都说有用，对你有用吗？"，再演示定规则、每天一键打卡、出结论、自动挑下一个实验。
videos.title_vi: Video ra mắt app thử nghiệm cá nhân Ren

vi.what: Video ra mắt 30 giây cho Ren, app thử nghiệm trên chính mình: mở bằng câu ai cũng bảo hiệu quả, rồi hỏi có hiệu quả với bạn không, sau đó đặt luật, điểm danh mỗi ngày, máy quay số ra kết luận và gợi ý thí nghiệm kế tiếp. Opus lo cả hình và âm thanh.
vi.why: Mô hình được quyền đọc repo nên nội dung bám đúng app. Đáng học cách dùng một câu hỏi đối thoại làm cú mở và máy quay số để tạo kịch tính trước khi lộ kết quả.
vi.how: Dùng cho app sức khỏe, thói quen, đo lường cá nhân. Cho mô hình quyền đọc repo và thay tên sản phẩm, thời lượng.

titles.en: Poster breaking out of its own frame

videos.author: pankajkumar_dev
videos.desc: A 30-second motion design piece where a poster breaks out of its frame, with camera moves and a self-composed soundtrack synced to the beat.
videos.prompt: create a motion design video of a poster breaking out of its own frame.
techniques: letterforms grow until they press against and deform the poster's thin border (chapter labels CONTROL → PRESSURE → ESCAPE → CHAOS → CONTROL)
poster sheet tilts into 3D space while its type and colour blocks slide out past the edge
giant letters drop onto an infinite perspective floor grid
camera dives through the counter of an 'O' into concentric primary-colour rings
collage climax of rotated words and primary shapes, then a reset to an empty frame with a single dot and credit
videos.summary_zh: 30 秒「海报冲破自己画框」的动态海报。FORM 先被框住，被挤压后逃出画框；海报卡片 3D 倾斜，字母掉到透视网格地面上，O 变成彩色隧道。一片混乱之后回到空框和作者署名。
videos.title_vi: Tấm poster tự phá khung của chính nó

vi.what: Đoạn motion 30 giây: chữ FORM bị khung giữ lại, phình to đến mức ép cong viền rồi thoát ra, tấm poster nghiêng vào không gian 3D, chữ rơi xuống mặt lưới phối cảnh và máy quay lao qua lòng chữ O thành đường hầm màu cơ bản. Sau cao trào cắt dán, mọi thứ trở về khung trống và chữ ký tác giả, có nhạc tự soạn khớp nhịp.
vi.why: Prompt chỉ một câu nhưng chứa một ý tưởng có xung đột rõ ràng, nên mô hình tự dựng được cấu trúc chương kiểm soát, áp lực, thoát ra, hỗn loạn rồi kiểm soát lại. Đáng học cách chọn một ẩn dụ hình ảnh làm trục cho cả phim.
vi.how: Dùng cho poster động, teaser sự kiện hoặc nhận diện có tinh thần phá cách. Thay vật thể bị giữ trong khung và có thể thêm bảng màu, phong cách như Bauhaus hay poster Thụy Sĩ.

videos.author: 1littlecoder
videos.desc: A 30-second code-rendered ad for Opus 5.5 that riffs on Apple's 1984 commercial; the author says it even checked its own sound levels.
videos.prompt: create a 30 second ad for Opus 5.5 inspired by Apple 1984 ad, iykyk! avoid the border text or frames!
videos.title_vi: Quảng cáo Opus 5.5 lấy cảm hứng từ Apple 1984

vi.what: Quảng cáo 30 giây cho Opus 5.5, render bằng code, chơi lại tinh thần quảng cáo 1984 của Apple. Tác giả cho biết mô hình còn tự kiểm tra mức âm thanh.
vi.why: Prompt dựa vào một quảng cáo kinh điển mà ai cũng biết để khỏi mô tả dài, và cấm chữ, khung ở viền. Đáng học cách vay cấu trúc kể chuyện của tác phẩm nổi tiếng thay vì sao chép hình.
vi.how: Dùng khi muốn quảng cáo có tính kể chuyện, nhại lại một mốc văn hóa. Thay sản phẩm và tác phẩm tham chiếu.

titles.en: GitHub README hero video for an open-source skill
titles.zh: 开源项目 README 主视频

videos.author: hqmank
videos.desc: A 23-second Remotion launch video for an open-source browser-agent skill, meant as the hero video at the top of its GitHub README.
videos.prompt: Make a dynamic 20-second motion graphics launch video for my open-source project jev-browser-skill ('Give a site. Write a goal. Jev clicks.'), like it's the hero video on its GitHub README. Go all out.
techniques: Kinetic headline stack 'GIVE A SITE. / WRITE A GOAL. / JEV CLICKS.' with a cursor click-burst ring on the accent word
Three-step input pipeline cards (SITE → GOAL → RUN) joined by a connector line, with numbered orange badges
Terminal types a real command, then status lines tick in (daemon started / chromium launched / recording)
Split view: a ghost cursor drives a mock website on the left while an agent action log (OBSERVE / CLICK / SCROLL) appends on the right
Full-bleed color slam cards 'ISOLATED.' and 'RECORDED.' with blur-to-sharp, ending on a git clone CTA with a copy-button click
videos.summary_zh: 开源浏览器自动化 skill「jev-browser-skill」的 23 秒发布视频，用作 GitHub README 首屏。
videos.title_vi: Video đầu trang README cho dự án mã nguồn mở

vi.what: Video ra mắt 23 giây dựng bằng Remotion cho skill agent trình duyệt jev-browser-skill, đặt ở đầu README trên GitHub: ba dòng tiêu đề chữ động, ba thẻ bước, terminal gõ lệnh thật, màn chia đôi con trỏ điều khiển website và nhật ký hành động của agent, kết bằng lệnh git clone.
vi.why: Prompt đưa khẩu hiệu ba câu của dự án và nêu rõ nơi video sẽ đặt, nên mô hình chọn đúng giọng dev tool. Đáng học cách chia màn hình cho thấy cùng lúc hành động và log.
vi.how: Dùng cho dự án mã nguồn mở cần video README hoặc trang giới thiệu. Thay tên dự án, khẩu hiệu và thời lượng.

titles.en: Earth from the dinosaurs to the Jōmon period
titles.zh: 从恐龙时代到绳文时代

videos.author: mellow_neet2000
videos.desc: A 140-second Japanese motion graphics lesson tracing Earth's history from the dinosaurs to Japan's Jōmon period, made from a three-line prompt.
videos.prompt:
動画を作りたい。
モーショングラフィックで地球の恐竜時代から縄文時代までの成り立ちと流れを教育的な切り口と視覚的な演出を意識しながら作ってほしい。
言語は日本語で。
videos.prompt_en:
I want to make a video.
Using motion graphics, make something about how the Earth took shape and unfolded from the age of dinosaurs to the Jōmon period, keeping an educational angle and visual staging in mind.
Use Japanese as the language.
videos.summary_zh: 原帖公开日文提示词，要求制作从地球恐龙时代到绳文时代的教育性动态图形视频，使用日语并重视视觉演出。
videos.title_vi: Trái Đất từ thời khủng long đến thời Jōmon

vi.what: Bài học motion graphics 140 giây bằng tiếng Nhật, kể quá trình hình thành Trái Đất từ thời khủng long đến thời kỳ Jōmon của Nhật Bản. Làm từ một prompt ba dòng.
vi.why: Prompt ba dòng nêu đủ hình thức (motion graphics), phạm vi thời gian, hai trọng tâm là góc nhìn giáo dục và cách dàn dựng hình ảnh, cùng ngôn ngữ. Đây là mẫu tối giản cho video giáo dục có trật tự thời gian.
vi.how: Hợp với video lịch sử, địa chất hay tiến hóa cho học sinh. Thay mốc bắt đầu, mốc kết thúc và chọn ngôn ngữ là tiếng Việt.

titles.en: Battle of Dan-no-ura as a 3D TV special

videos.author: tetumemo
videos.desc: A 74-second 3D overhead reconstruction of the Battle of Dan-no-ura, showing fleets, shifting tidal currents and low cameras skimming the sea.
videos.prompt:
壇ノ浦の戦いをテレビ特番級3D俯瞰デモ化。
地形・軍勢・進軍矢印・霧・カメラ移動を滑らかに演出。
さらに、関門海峡の潮流、源氏と平氏の船団配置、潮の反転による戦況変化を立体的に可視化する。
海面すれすれの低空カメラ、船団を追う旋回カメラ、水しぶきや海霧を加え、戦況の変化が直感的に伝わる映像にする。
videos.prompt_en:
Turn the Battle of Dan-no-ura into a TV-special-grade 3D overhead demo.
Smoothly stage the terrain, armies, advance arrows, fog and camera moves.
Also visualize in 3D the tidal currents of the Kanmon Strait, the positions of the Genji and Heike fleets, and how the reversal of the tide changed the course of the battle.
Add a low camera skimming the sea surface, an orbiting camera following the fleets, spray and sea mist, so the shifts in the battle come across intuitively.
videos.title_vi: Tái hiện 3D trận Dan-no-ura kiểu phóng sự truyền hình

vi.what: Bản dựng 3D nhìn từ trên cao dài 74 giây về trận Dan-no-ura: địa hình, hạm đội hai phe Genji và Heike, dòng hải lưu ở eo biển Kanmon đảo chiều, camera bay sát mặt biển.
vi.why: Prompt nhắm vào chất lượng phóng sự truyền hình và nêu cụ thể yếu tố cần dựng: địa hình, quân, mũi tên tiến quân, sương mù. Điểm hay là nó yêu cầu hình hóa nguyên nhân đổi cục diện (thủy triều đảo chiều) và mô tả hai kiểu camera, sát mặt nước và bay vòng theo hạm đội.
vi.how: Hợp với video lịch sử quân sự hay giải thích một sự kiện có yếu tố địa lý quyết định. Thay trận đánh, địa danh và yếu tố tự nhiên chi phối diễn biến.

titles.en: Showreel prompt turned app launch video
titles.zh: 作品集提示词改成应用发布片

videos.author: MustaphaFenzar
videos.desc: The famous showreel prompt plus one line that turns it into a 15-second launch video for the Mounis app, made in one shot.
videos.prompt:
make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out.

  it should be a launch app video for https://mounis.app/

titles.zh: 陨石空爆压倒整片森林

videos.author: FornYapayZeka
videos.desc: A replayable all-code simulation: a meteor explodes over a forest, a pressure model decides which of 240,000 trees fall, then a satellite damage map appears.
videos.prompt:
Yapabileceğin en etkileyici patlama efektini ve onu taşıyacak özgün sahneyi üret. Ölçeği, ortamı ve görsel dili sen seç. Patlamanın başlangıcı, kuvvetin yayılması ve ardında bıraktığı değişim izlenebilir olsun; tek karelik parlama veya rastgele parçacık yağmuru yeterli değil. Kullanıcı bunu tekrar başlatabilsin ve etkisini farklı açıdan görebilsin.

Yaratıcı seçimler senin: sahne, sanat yönü, kamera, mekanik, teknoloji ve etkileşimi önceden belirlenmiş sıradan kalıplara sıkıştırma. İlk akla gelen sıradan web demosuyla yetinme: önce kendi alanında birkaç fikri kısaca tart, videoda en güçlü görünecek özgün olanı seç, sonra onu çalışan bir ürüne dönüştür. Konuyu olduğundan kolay gösteren dekoratif taklit kabul edilmez. Sinematik ve estetik seçimler sonuçta görülsün.
videos.prompt_en:
Produce the most impressive explosion effect you can, and an original scene to carry it. Choose the scale, the setting and the visual language yourself. The start of the explosion, the spread of the force and the change it leaves behind should all be traceable; a single-frame flash or a random shower of particles is not enough. The user should be able to restart it and see its effect from a different angle.

The creative choices are yours: do not squeeze the scene, art direction, camera, mechanics, technology and interaction into predefined ordinary templates. Do not settle for the ordinary web demo that comes to mind first: first briefly weigh a few ideas in your own domain, pick the original one that will look strongest in the video, then turn it into a working product. A decorative imitation that makes the subject look easier than it is will not be accepted. Let the cinematic and aesthetic choices show in the result.

titles.en: Pixel-art rabbit archer sprite animation loop
titles.zh: 像素风兔子弓箭手动画

videos.author: KanaWorks_AI
videos.desc: A looping 16-bit style sprite showcase of a cyborg rabbit archer cycling through eight actions, drawn procedurally in Canvas 2D at 160x120 from a character reference.
videos.prompt:
Create a single self-contained HTML file that renders an animated pixel art rabbit archer character using vanilla JavaScript and Canvas 2D.

Use the attached KANA rabbit character as the visual reference:
- White rabbit
- Large upright ears with cyan/blue glowing inner-ear details
- One normal blue eye
- One red cybernetic mechanical eye
- Yellow hoodie with “KANA”
- Dark blue gloves and pants
- Yellow/blue sci-fi mechanical leg armor
- Cute chibi proportions
- Futuristic bow and arrow weapon
- Small quiver on the back

Do not use external assets, libraries, images, fonts, or network requests.
Everything must be drawn procedurally with code.

RENDERING
- Render everything first to an offscreen canvas at a fixed logical resolution of 160x120.
- Scale it to a fullscreen display canvas using the largest integer scale that fits the browser window.
- Center the canvas.
- Set imageSmoothingEnabled = false.
- Use CSS image-rendering: pixelated.
- All coordinates must snap to integers.
- No gradients, blur, anti-aliasing, shadowBlur, or sub-pixel rendering.
- Use a fixed palette of approximately 28 colors:
  dark navy background colors,
  white/gray fur,
  yellow hoodie colors,
  blue clothing colors,
  red cyber-eye colors,
  cyan ear-light colors,
  yellow/orange bow and arrow effects.

CHARACTER
Build the rabbit procedurally from pixel rectangles, polygon-like pixel runs, circles approximated with pixels, and simple block shapes.

Approximate character size:
- 28–34 pixels wide
- 40–48 pixels tall

Keep the silhouette clearly recognizable:
- Large rabbit ears
- Round fluffy head
- Small body
- Cybernetic red eye
- Yellow hoodie
- Mechanical legs
- Bow
- Arrow
- Quiver

Animate ears, head, arms, legs, hoodie, bow, arrow, and body separately.

Quantize animation poses so that although the main loop renders at 60fps, the visual animation feels like polished 8–12fps sprite animation.

ACTIONS

Create a looping animation showcase containing these 8 actions:

1. IDLE
- Rabbit stands ready
- Slight body bob
- Ears move subtly
- Hoodie and quiver sway
- Cyber eye pulses softly
- Bow held relaxed at the side

2. RUN
- Fast forward running animation
- Strong alternating leg motion
- Arms balance the movement
- Bow held in one hand
- Quiver bounces
- Ears trail slightly backward
- Small dust pixels appear under the feet

3. AIM
- Rabbit plants feet firmly
- Raises bow
- Pulls arrow from quiver
- Nocks arrow
- Draws bowstring backward
- One eye focuses on target
- Cyber eye becomes brighter
- Body leans slightly into the shot

4. SHOOT
- Release the bowstring
- Arrow fires rapidly across the screen
- Bow recoils slightly
- Rabbit’s arm follows through
- Bright yellow energy trail follows the arrow
- Small 1–2 pixel screen shake
- Cyber eye flashes red
- Brief muzzle-like light burst from bow

5. JUMP
- Rabbit crouches
- Jumps upward
- Legs tuck under body
- Ears react with delayed motion
- Bow held close to body
- Small dust burst on takeoff
- Slight squash and stretch using pixel-safe integer transformations

6. DODGE / ROLL
- Rabbit quickly ducks
- Rolls sideways
- Bow is kept close to the body
- Ears flatten backward
- Small dust particles and motion pixels
- End in a low combat-ready pose

7. HURT / HIT
- Rabbit gets knocked backward slightly
- Head snaps back
- Ears react dramatically
- Cyber eye flickers
- Small pixel stars or impact sparks appear
- Bow lowers or nearly drops
- Character recovers after a short delay

8. VICTORY
- Rabbit raises bow overhead
- Happy expression
- One ear tilts playfully
- Cyber eye glows brightly
- Small yellow celebration particles appear
- Character performs a short victory bounce
- End pose should feel cute and heroic

STATE MACHINE

Use this loop:

IDLE
→ RUN
→ AIM
→ SHOOT
→ JUMP
→ DODGE
→ HURT
→ VICTORY
→ IDLE

Each action should last long enough to clearly read visually.

Use easing functions for pose transitions.

Add short transition animations between states so the loop feels continuous instead of abruptly switching poses.

BOW AND ARROW
- Futuristic curved bow
- White / dark navy body
- Yellow glowing mechanical joints
- Thin bright bowstring
- Arrow has a bright yellow arrowhead
- Arrow trail during SHOOT should last briefly
- Quiver contains several visible arrows

PARTICLES
Implement an allocation-free pooled particle system.

Preallocate all particles before the animation loop.

Particle types:
- Foot dust
- Arrow trail
- Bow energy sparks
- Cyber eye sparks
- Hit stars
- Victory particles

Each particle changes palette color as it ages.

Do not allocate new objects inside the main loop.

SCENE
Create a minimal pixel-art environment:
- Dark night sky
- A few 1px stars
- Large moon
- Simple stone or futuristic platform
- Very subtle distant silhouettes

The background must remain simple so the rabbit silhouette is always readable.

Add subtle cyan/red rim lighting from the cybernetic eye and yellow rim lighting from the bow during AIM and SHOOT.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Single HTML file
- Vanilla JavaScript only
- Canvas 2D only
- No libraries
- No SVG
- No external images
- No assets
- No network requests
- Fixed 60Hz timestep
- requestAnimationFrame for rendering
- Zero object allocation inside the main animation loop
- Stable 60fps
- Responsive fullscreen scaling
- Crisp integer-scaled pixels

QUALITY BAR
The result should look like a polished 16-bit action-game protagonist sprite animation.

Avoid the appearance of simple geometric shapes.

The rabbit should feel expressive, cute, fast, and combat-capable.

The eight actions must all have clearly different silhouettes.

The character design must remain consistent across every animation state.

The final result should feel suitable for an actual pixel-art action game.

titles.en: Kinetic typography speech: Build the Floor
titles.zh: 文字搭成平台的演讲短片

videos.author: Gdgtify
videos.desc: A 20-second 1080×1080 kinetic-type film where a five-line speech's words become lintel, supports and platform, as a deterministic, seamlessly looping SVG/Canvas HTML.
videos.prompt: Create a 20.00-second kinetic spoken-word film titled “BUILD THE FLOOR.”  Treat this as an original miniature speech staged entirely through typography. Every line changes the architecture of the frame. The final declaration must stand on something the earlier words physically constructed.  Deliver one self-contained HTML file, 1080×1080, targeting 60fps, using SVG and/or Canvas. Embed all required assets.  ART DIRECTION Background #102820. Paper # F4E9D5. Structural accent # F2B544. A literary editorial world with the scale and confidence of a public monument. Use a high-contrast serif for the speech, a heavy grotesque for load-bearing words, and a restrained monospace for small timing marks. No distressed protest-poster clichés, megaphones, flags, crowds, microphones, or stock footage.  ORIGINAL SPEECH — EXACT WORDS, EXACT ORDER “We were told to wait.” “So we learned the weight of waiting.” “Then one voice made room.” “Then another.” “Now the floor belongs to us.”  Do not attribute these words to any real person. No extra slogans. The complete speech must be understandable without audio.  CENTRAL VISUAL RULE Words have assigned architectural roles. WAIT is a lintel. WAITING is a suspended load. VOICE is a support. ROOM is an opening. FLOOR is a platform. These roles must emerge from the actual letterforms, not from separate illustrations placed behind text.  STORYBOARD 0.00–3.00 “We were told to wait.” The sentence occupies a narrow horizontal opening beneath a massive WAIT. The opening slowly compresses while the sentence remains readable. The pressure comes from the layout, not camera shake.  3.00–6.50 “So we learned the weight of waiting.” Reveal the sentence in spoken phrase groups. WAITING lowers on two fine vertical rules. Those rules become suspension cables. A baseline bends under the visual load using a controlled vector deformation.  6.50–10.00 “Then one voice made room.” VOICE enters vertically and rotates into a structural support. It lifts one end of the baseline. The counter of the O in ROOM becomes an aperture. The next composition is revealed through that aperture.  10.00–12.50 “Then another.” A second support arrives. The tilted structure levels. This is the first moment of perfect horizontal alignment in the film. Use a brief stillness to make the change feel earned.  12.50–16.00 “Now the floor belongs to us.” Earlier structural words assemble into a platform. The final sentence settles onto it. US receives emphasis through shared alignment and scale, never through a separate flashy effect.  16.00–18.00 Hold the complete declaration. A slight release of tension travels through the supporting rules. No new text. No restless decorative motion.  18.00–20.00 The camera tracks beneath the completed platform. Its underside fills the frame and becomes the opening WAIT lintel. Under full occlusion, return hidden elements to their initial positions. Reveal the exact opening composition.  CHOREOGRAPHY Do not force the speech onto a dance beat. Use a cue sheet based on phrases, pauses, and emphasis. Phrase reveals should follow reading order. Allow at least one 400ms moment of absolute stillness. Use critically damped motion for settling loads. Use controlled elastic deformation for the baseline only. Make the changes in available space carry the emotional progression.  TYPE IMPLEMENTATION Use actual glyph paths for structural words. Preserve counters and legibility during deformation. For transitions between unrelated words, use occlusion or matched structural edges; do not interpolate arbitrary path points. Keep the currently spoken phrase readable before it becomes architecture.  ENGINEERING Implement window. seek(t) as a deterministic scene renderer. No accumulated physics, autonomous CSS transitions, or changing random values. Use time-remapping curves and analytic transforms. Use a 20-second periodic timeline with render(0)=render(20). Provide fixed-step access at n/60 for 1200 export frames. Audio is optional and off by default; no browser speech synthesis or autoplay dependency.  QUALITY GATE Inspect eight representative frames. Check that the speech reads in the correct order. Check that structural transformations never destroy a line before the audience can read it. Check the final platform is visibly assembled from earlier elements. Return the complete HTML implementation.
techniques: 整段话压在巨大的 WAIT 下面一条窄缝里，缝慢慢变窄
WAITING 挂在两根细竖线上，竖线变吊索，基线被压弯
VOICE 竖着进场再转成立柱，撑起基线一端；第二根 VOICE 进来后整体第一次水平
前面出现过的结构词拼成平台，最后一句落在上面
镜头钻到平台底下，底面变回开场的 WAIT 门楣，首尾无缝循环（render(0)=render(20)）
videos.summary_zh: 20 秒动态文字短片《BUILD THE FLOOR》：WAIT 是门楣、WAITING 是吊起的重物、VOICE 是立柱、FLOOR 是平台，一句句话把画面里的结构搭起来。

videos.prompt:
create a music video for this entire song, check lyrics.txt to sync the visuals to. style should be a mix between monty-python/vox style "postcards in space" mixed with sketchy ballpoint pen style visuals. this needs to look professional. theme of the video is a creepy evil pizza parlor, camera starts outside and works through the inside, through a secret bookshelf door into a basement with untold horrors and pizza sauce all over the place. use whatever tools or methods you need to make this look professional. final export should be an .mp4 of the entire music video.

I might never open After Effects again.

titles.en: Journey of a photon, storybook explainer
titles.zh: 光子的旅程：绘本风讲解

videos.author: AstroTheWizard
videos.desc: A 60-second storybook-style science explainer following a photon out of the Sun, with a real random-walk simulation, TTS narration, captions and an original score.
videos.prompt:
I want you to make a 60-second, fully animated explainer video, end to end, completely on your own. I'm stepping away from my computer, so work autonomously until it's done. Don't stop to ask me questions; make the calls yourself and tell me what you decided at the end.

Topic: the journey of photons 

Style: whimsical, charming, storybook. Give the photon a personality. It should feel like a professional motion-design studio made it, not "AI video". The whole thing should be a pure JavaScript animation, rendered from code frame by frame. Don't use AI video generators for the visuals. I've seen the videos people are posting from Opus 5.5 (kinetic typography reels, continuous infinite zooms, data-driven explainers like The Pudding or 3Blue1Brown), and what makes them great is that they're code-rendered: crisp, precise, with a coherent design system and one strong formal idea per scene. Aim for that bar or above.

Make it genuinely educational and accurate. Where you can, simulate the real thing: the random walk should be an actual random walk, not a drawing of one. Include real numbers (core temperature, distance, travel time, years inside the Sun) and be honest about uncertainty in the estimates. Use humor and visual gags to keep attention: onomatopoeia, little characters, callbacks. Put what was happening on Earth during those 100,000 years alongside the photon's timeline.

Deliverable: 1920x1080 at 60fps, exactly 60 seconds, with:
- A voiceover script you write yourself, voiced with the highest-quality text-to-speech model you can access
- Burned-in captions, since most people watch on X with the sound off
- An original music score that fits the whimsical tone and changes with each scene
- Sound design synced exactly to the on-screen action (every bounce, pop, whoosh and ding)
- A professional mix: music ducks under the voice, mastered to streaming loudness

You write the script, design the characters, pick the typography and palette, compose the music, and build the animation engine. Use any tools and resources you can find access to: open fonts, sample libraries, open-source models. Use whatever works.

Quality is paramount. Build verification loops: render stills of every scene and review them critically, check transitions frame by frame, measure the audio mix numerically, fix what's weak and re-render. Don't hand me a first draft. Hand me something you'd put your name on. Also give me the source code so it's reproducible

titles.en: Podcast cut filled with explainer animations
titles.zh: 给播客成片插满讲解动画

videos.author: stokebuilder
videos.desc: A multi-agent workflow that finds 35–50 moments in a podcast cut and adds on-brand full-screen HyperFrames animations with the speaker in picture-in-picture.
videos.prompt:
Go through the entire [episode] cut and add full-screen animations and graphics wherever they help. Be aggressive and over-inclusive: 35–50 moments, at least 2 per chapter. The goal is to fill empty talking-head time, explain ideas, and create visual hooks.

Style. Pick an aesthetic that's genuinely interesting and very, very cool, built in JavaScript with HyperFrames and assembled in Tesseract. Inspiration (all JS, no image assets):

https://x.com/Voxyz_ai/status/2102531681450119426: paper, typewriter-tape labels, hand-drawn marks
https://x.com/donaldjewkes/status/2102801274173587569: halftone, manga and pixel print, kinetic data type

Stay inside the LegalQuants brand (read brands/legalquants/): charcoal, white and black only, Arial, and the supplied lockup top-right, static. Write a shared style bible and a component kit first, so every animation looks like the same show.

Moments I definitely want:

[LIST]

Rules

Whenever anything goes full-screen (animation, screen share or still), one of us is in a corner picture-in-picture, bottom-right, following whoever is talking.
No punch-ins or zooming on the cameras. Keep each speaker relatively centered.
Copy must be verbatim or faithful to what's said. Never invent facts, numbers or quotes.
Sync each animation's beats to the spoken words.
Keep each graphic inside one uncut stretch of audio, and leave a few seconds of faces between graphics.

Process

An Opus 5.5 agent at extra-high effort finds every timestamp where an animation could fill space and hook the viewer, with a concept for each.
Opus 5.5 at medium effort builds each animation.
Opus 5.5 at extra-high effort judges each one once on brand consistency with the others, visual interest, relevance to the narrative and creative judgment.
Only cues the judge considers egregiously bad go back for a fix. No blanket redo loops.
Assemble the full cut with PiP baked into every full-screen visual, and give me a folder of the individual animations.
videos.title_vi: Chèn hoạt hình giải thích vào bản dựng podcast

titles.en: A bug that doesn't want to be fixed

videos.author: KamStudioLabs
videos.desc: A 90-second animated short film starring a software bug that resists being fixed; the second in a series of one-line prompt tests.
videos.prompt: Make a 90-second animated short film about a bug that doesn't want to be fixed.
techniques: Code abstracted into rounded syntax-coloured pill bars (unreadable but instantly 'code') with a blinking caret
Giant shaded mouse cursor as the antagonist; crosshair reticle hunting the character
Error line flares as a full-width red highlight band with red squiggle underline
Bug hides by posing as the text caret (vertical glow bar)
Bookend pull-back from code close-up to a silhouetted developer at a monitor in a dark room; the bug's glow remains on screen at the end
videos.summary_zh: 90 秒动画短片：一只不想被修复的萤火虫小 bug 藏在代码里，躲避巨大鼠标光标的追捕。
videos.title_vi: Con bug không muốn bị sửa

vi.what: Phim hoạt hình 90 giây về một con bug phát sáng như đom đóm trốn trong code, né con trỏ chuột khổng lồ đang săn nó. Đây là phim thứ hai trong loạt thử nghiệm prompt một câu của tác giả.
vi.why: Code được trừu tượng hóa thành các thanh bo tròn tô màu cú pháp, không đọc được nhưng nhìn là biết code. Con trỏ chuột làm phản diện, dòng lỗi bừng lên dải đỏ, bug trốn bằng cách giả làm dấu nháy, và phim mở đóng bằng cú lùi máy ra người lập trình ngồi trước màn hình trong phòng tối.
vi.how: Hợp với video vui cho cộng đồng lập trình hay thương hiệu công cụ phát triển phần mềm. Thay nhân vật và tình huống trong câu prompt, giữ độ dài và thể loại phim ngắn.

videos.desc: An 18-second pure JavaScript animation of a samurai performing a routine on one spot, cycling through poses amid fire effects.

Procedural line-art rig with glowing sword trails; each strike bursts ember particles
Elliptical ground shockwave rings expanding on each cut
Finale: giant translucent kanji 炎 watermark laid over the red sun
Real-time canvas with on-screen interaction hints instead of a pre-rendered clip
videos.summary_zh: 纯 JavaScript 画的火焰武士在原地演一套刀法，每个招式配一张日文汉字招式名卡。
videos.title_vi: Samurai múa kiếm giữa biển lửa, vẽ bằng JavaScript

videos.author: loicRambo
videos.desc: A 20-second looping motion-design showreel following one person from childhood through the 9-to-5, family and old age to death and back.

techniques: continuous ground line runs through every scene and finally becomes an ECG/flatline that draws the two figures as light strokes
persistent corner HUD: age counter (16, 27, 35…) with stage label and BPM heartbeat readout that changes per scene
shape-mask transitions: circular iris for childhood, heart-shaped mask for family life, clock face becoming a hamster wheel for the 9-5
same character redesigned per life stage, walking/skating in place while the world changes around him
videos.summary_zh: 「生命循环」20 秒角色动画：同一个人从婴儿、少年、朝九晚五、成家、老年到离世，再无缝循环。

titles.en: Cute creatures explain how LLMs work
titles.zh: 萌物讲解大语言模型原理

videos.author: eyishazyer
videos.desc: A 40-second 1080x1080 Remotion explainer where blob creatures walk through tokens, embeddings, attention and prediction, with TTS narration and a Python-made score.
videos.prompt:
Create a 40-second animated video explaining how Large Language Models (LLMs) work.

Every frame must be generated from code. No stock footage. No video generators. No image editors.

The video must feature cute animated creatures that help explain the process. Make it fun, watchable, and technically accurate.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
Use Remotion (React/TypeScript) for the animation

Draw all visuals in SVG and Canvas
Use an open-source TTS voice for narration
Synthesize a light, playful score in Python
Export as MP4, 1080x1080 (square for X)
40 seconds total
VIDEO STRUCTURE

0-5s: Hook
Black screen. A small glowing dot appears in the center.

Text types out: "Ever wonder how AI actually thinks?"
The dot expands into a cute, simple creature, like a tiny round blob with big eyes. It blinks and looks around.

5-12s: Tokens (The Input)
The creature receives a sentence: "The cat sat on the..."

The sentence breaks apart into small glowing puzzle pieces, these are tokens.
Each token floats toward the creature, who catches them one by one.
Narration: "First, your words get broken into tokens, small pieces of language."
Cute detail: each token has a tiny face and waves as it flies in.

12-20s: Embeddings (The Map)
The creature holds the tokens and they transform into colorful little gems.

The gems arrange themselves into a 3D map, a colorful cloud of dots.
Similar gems cluster together. "Cat" gems are near "dog" gems. "King" gems are near "queen" gems.
Narration: "Each token becomes a point in a giant map of meaning."
Cute detail: the creature walks around the map, pointing at clusters like a tour guide.

20-28s: Attention (The Thinking)
The creature stops. Multiple tiny creatures appear around it, each one is an "attention head."

They all look at different parts of the map at once.
Lines of light connect the important tokens to each other. "The" connects to "cat." "Sat" connects to "on."
Narration: "The model pays attention to what matters, connecting the dots between words."
Cute detail: the attention creatures nod at each other as they find connections.

28-35s: Prediction (The Output)
The main creature now stands in front of a giant scoreboard.

Hundreds of possible next words appear as floating bubbles: "mat" (biggest), "floor" (small), "moon" (tiny).
The creature reaches up and picks the biggest bubble "mat."
Narration: "Then it predicts the next word and the one after that, and the one after that."
Cute detail: the creature looks proud as it picks the right word.

35-40s: The Kicker
The creature takes the new word and feeds it back into the loop.

The screen fills with a chain of words forming a sentence: "The cat sat on the mat."
The creature smiles, waves at the camera.
Text fades in: "That's how LLMs work. One word at a time."
Narration: "One token at a time. That's the whole trick."
VISUAL STYLE
Dark background (deep navy or charcoal) with soft glowing accents

Cute, simple creature design, round, big eyes, minimal detail, expressive

Tokens and gems have soft glowing edges

Colors: warm gold, soft blue, gentle pink, mint green
Lines and connections drawn in soft neon
Typography: clean sans-serif, white or light gray
Everything should feel warm, playful, and technically clear
AUDIO
TTS voiceover: warm, friendly, slightly curious tone
Script:"Ever wonder how AI actually thinks?"
"First, your words get broken into tokens, small pieces of language."
"Each token becomes a point in a giant map of meaning."
"The model pays attention to what matters, connecting the dots between words."
"Then it predicts the next word, and the one after that, and the one after that."
"One token at a time. That's the whole trick."

Background score: light, playful electronic tune with a soft bounce

Sound effects: soft pops when tokens appear, gentle chimes when connections form

OUTPUT
Export as MP4, 1080x1080
Include the code so it can be re-run with new explanations
Make it easy to add new creatures or scenes later
Build a cute, fast, visually engaging 40-second video that explains LLMs clearly and makes people smile while they learn.

titles.en: Night train crossing a mountain viaduct
titles.zh: 穿越山间高架桥的夜行列车

videos.author: Artless101
videos.desc: A procedural Three.js night scene of a burgundy train looping over a stone viaduct, with four cameras, lighting presets and Web Audio ambience.
videos.prompt:
Create a polished, fully interactive 3D artwork called "Nocturne - The Highland Night Train" using Three.js and WebGL. Deliver the entire experience as one standalone HTML file that opens directly in Chrome. Generate the models, materials and textures procedurally, and embed dependencies so the final file can also work offline. Start from scratch and give the scene its own visual identity.

ART DIRECTION
An elegant burgundy night express crosses a monumental curved stone viaduct above a deep alpine valley. Dense conifer forests, a winding river, distant cottages and rugged snow-covered mountains surround the railway. Use a cinematic, carefully detailed miniature style, with cool moonlight, deep blue shadows and warm golden carriage windows. The result should feel like a finished interactive artwork, with thoughtful composition and readable details.

THE TRAIN
Build a convincing diesel locomotive and four passenger carriages. Use deep burgundy paint, cream stripes, brass handrails and charcoal roofs. Model rounded body panels, cab windows, front lamps, radiator grilles, roof fans, exhaust, walkways, steps, buffers, couplings, bogies, wheel flanges and suspension details. Include window frames, curtains and subtle passenger silhouettes. Keep windows and decorative parts visibly outside the body surfaces, without intersections or flickering.

RAILWAY AND MOVEMENT
Create a continuous elliptical railway loop supported by a tall masonry viaduct. Construct actual open arches, piers, individual arch stones, parapets, rails and sleepers. Add procedural stone variation and subtle surface relief. Supports must meet the terrain and the track must have no gaps.

Move the train at a believable, steady speed using an arc-length-parameterized route. Position and orient every carriage independently. Keep the wheels aligned with the rails and make bogies follow the track correctly through turns. Couplings must remain connected without overlapping carriages. Add restrained suspension movement, rotating wheels and exhaust that drifts away into world space.

ENVIRONMENT AND LIGHTING
Use thousands of efficiently instanced conifers with varied heights, shapes and colors. Sculpt irregular mountain ridges with snow on the upper slopes. Add atmospheric depth, a starry sky, a moon halo and a softly feathered headlight beam through the mist. Use warm windows, controlled bloom, soft shadows and subtle color grading. Preserve detail in the train and bridge instead of crushing them into black silhouettes.

INTERACTION
Provide four smoothly transitioning cameras: Cinematic, Train, Window Seat and Free Orbit. Let users rotate and zoom freely. Keep useful framing on both desktop and mobile.

Add distinctly different Moonlight, Blue Hour and First Light presets. Include play/pause, speed controls, a horn button, sound on/off, volume and an option to hide the interface. Use a restrained English-only interface with elegant typography and unobtrusive controls.

AUDIO AND QUALITY
Synthesize quiet railway ambience with Web Audio: a low engine rumble, gentle wheel rhythm, wind and a distant-sounding horn. Start audio only after a user interaction and respect the volume control.

Balance visual richness with smooth performance using instancing, geometry batching and sensible rendering limits. Test the finished HTML in desktop Chrome, capture screenshots, inspect the console and fix visible or technical issues. Verify every control, camera transitions, a complete train circuit, mobile resizing and direct offline opening. Return the final HTML file.
